tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gdugs dkar la brten pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i lag len gyi cho ga bzhugs so// gtsug tor gdugs dkar la brten pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs chog dga' ldan du myur du bgrod pa'i nye lam zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das gdugs dkar 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'di nyid kyi mchog grub las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo zhes bya ba gzhan gyi mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa rig sngags rgyal mo 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te rim gro cher mchod pa chen po byas la/ grong khyer gyi sgo'am/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong brdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i gnas su gzugs so/ /'phags pa gzhan gyi mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa chen mo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo ni/ rim gro cher byas te btsugs na btsugs ma thag tu g.yul du zhi bar byas par 'gyur ro/ /yams gyi nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ rang gzhan gyi nye bar 'tshe ba dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs la sogs pa bzlog pa'i ched du rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i cho ga byed pa la gsum ste sbyor ba bshams pa/ dngos gzhi rgyal mtshan 'dzugs pa'i cho ga rjes mjug gi cho ga'o/ /dang po ni spyir rgyal mtshan la bum pa'i rnam pa dang / dril bu'i rnam pa lta bu'i rgyal mtshan la sogs pa bshad pa las/ da lta phyi ma grags che bas de lta bu'i rgyal mtshan 'di la rgyal mtshan dkar po res ral gsal ltan du mdzad 'dug kyang 'di la gser dngul sogs rin po che rgyal mtshan gang yang rung ba'i phyir ro/ /dkar po shin tu mdzes pa spos dkar gyi shing ngam/ de ma 'byor na/ 'o ma can gyi shing gang yang rung ba'i srog shing byas pa la/ srog shing brtan pa'i sngags/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ zhes pa bris/ tog la gdugs dkar mo'i sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sogs byas la 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs ngos zhal bstan te bkod pa/

brlan gyi mi gnod pa'i nang du 'di nyid kyi gzungs sngags tshang bar bzhugs/ sku la 'byor na tog gi nang du gzungs rnams mgo mjug ma nor bar zhugs/ rgyal mtshan gyi spyi bo'i nang du 'di nyid kyi bsrung 'khor legs par bris la bzhugs par bya'o/ /de la shu raṃ ga badzra gyis lugs dang / slob dpon tsaṇḍa go ma'i lugs gnyis las phyi ma ltar na/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs phran lte ba'i zlum bskor gcig de'i phyir 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi sar sor mo gnyis kyi tshad du bskor/ de'i phyir yang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi sar sor gnyis kyi tshad du bskor/ de'i phyir sngags 'phreng gcig gshong ba'i sa zlum por bskor/ de'i phyir sngags 'phreng gnyis kyi sar zlum por bskor/ de'i phyir rdo rwa me ris dang bcas pa bya'o/ /lte ba la/ mchog grub/ oṃ ri shi ga na pra shapta sarba ta thā ga toṣṇi a si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ bhrūm̐/ 'chang ba la yul phyogs 'di la 'jigs pa dang / gdon dang zas sna tshogs za ba dang / rig sngags 'chang gi gnod pa thams cad rakṣa rakṣa swāhā/ zhes dang steng 'og gi lha mos sngags/ aṣṭa nāṃ ma hā gra hā ṇāṃ bi dhā na sa na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ/ 'chang ba la gza' chen po brgyad kyi 'tshe ba thams cad rakṣa rakṣa swāhā/ zhes pa yig 'go phyir bstan te zlum po bris/ yul 'khor dang grong khyer du rims nad bsrung ba dang / dmag la sogs pa bzlog pa'i ched du yin na/ yul che ge mo 'dir rims dang pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad rakṣa rakṣa/ zhes pa lta bu'i skabs dang sbyar ba'i spel tshig 'dzud shes par byas la/ de nas shar gyi rtsibs la/ oṃ dzaṃ bha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ/ yul phyogs 'dir gdon dang 'tshe ba thams cad rakṣa rakṣa swāhā/ lho'i rtsibs la/ oṃ staṃ bha na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ/ nub kyi rtsibs la/ oṃ ma hā bi dye saṃ bhakṣa ṇa ka ri hūm̐ druṃ/ byang gi rtsibs la/ oṃ pa ra bi dye saṃ bhakṣa ṇa ka ri hūm̐ druṃ/

byang shar gyi rtsibs la/ oṃ sarba duṣṭaṃ staṃ bha na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ/ shar lho'i rtsibs la/ oṃ sarba yakṣa rakṣa sa gra hā ṇaṃ bi dhwansa na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ/ lho nub kyi rtsibs la/ oṃ tsa tu rā shi tī nāṃ gra ha sa ha srā ṇaṃ bi dhwansa na ka ra'i hūm̐ druṃ/ nub byang gi rtsibs la/ oṃ aṣṭa biṃ sha tī nāṃ nakṣa tra ṇaṃ pra sa dha na ka rī hūm̐ druṃ/ zhes par bri bar bya'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi shar gyi rtsibs la/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ lho'i rtsibs la/ oṃ kha sa me kha sa me/ nub kyi rtsibs la/ oṃ bai ra bai ra/ byang gi rtsibs la/ oṃ sau me sau me/ byang shar gyi rtsibs la/ oṃ badzra dha ri bhandha bhandha nāṃ/ shar lho'i rtsibs la/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi phaṭa/ lho nub kyi rtsibs la/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ nub byang gi rtsibs la/ oṃ hūm̐ druṃ bhandha phaṭa/ rtsibs phyi nang gi sngags rnams kyi mjug tu/ 'chang ba la gdon dang 'tshe ba thams cad rakṣa rakṣa swāhā swāhā/ zhes pa'i spel tshig bri bar bya'o/ /de'i phyir 'khor yug la/ tadya thā/ oṃ ṣṭoṃ bhandha bhandha badzra ma ma rakṣa rakṣa badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇi ṣa a wa lo ki te tsurṇa te dzwa ra shi oṃ hūm̐ dzwa la dzwa la/ da ka da ka da ra da ra/ bhi da ra bhi da ra/ tstshindha tstshindha/ bhindha bhindha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇi ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le/ a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra/ swau me swau me/ sarba bhuddha a tiṣṭha nā a tiṣṭha te/ sarba ta thā ga toṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ ma ma hūm̐ ni 'chang ba la rakṣa rakṣa swāhā/ zhes bri bar bya'o/ /de'i phyir khor yug la/ oṃ a si tā na larka ces sogs nas/ sha ma sha na bā si nī ye phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar dang / 'chang ba la gdon dang rims dang nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad rakṣa rakṣa swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar bri bar bya'o/ /'khor lo'i rgyab tu/

oṃ sarba bi dye swāhā/ oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzre swāhā/ ces pa bri/ de nas srung ba de nyid ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i steng du maṇḍal padma 'dab brgyad byas/ de'i steng du srung ba lte ba'i sngags phreng gi zhal rang gi ngos la bstan pa bzhag de'i mthar mchod pa'i tshogs 'byor pa bshams/ de nas stan la 'khod de rang gi mdun du lcog rtse'i khar rang gi g.yon du rdo rje g.yas su dril bu zhal rang la bstan pa de dag phyir rang gi g.yon nas 'go byas te nyer mchod bshams/ kha cig gso sbyong blang ba'i skabs su rten khyim pa yin na blang dgos kyi/ dge slong dge tshul gyi blang mi dgos gsungs zer te/ gsungs pa mi bden pa'i phyir/ bden srid na sdom pa len pa'i go rim gyi rnam gzhag ma chags pa yin te dge bsnyen la srog gcod spong ba'i sdom pa yod kyang / dge tshul gyi bslabs pa len pa na/ srog gcod spong ba'i sdom pa blangs dgos la/ de ni dge slong byed pa na yang srog gcod spong ba'i sdom pa blangs dgos pa bzhin dge slong bzang po byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa len pa na/ sngar mi dge ba spong ba'i sdom pa yod kyang / yang mi dge ba spong ba'i sdom pa len pa'i phyir dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sdom ldan gsang sngags kyi 'gor 'jug pas na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed blangs dgos shing / dge sbyor thun re'i 'go la yang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya dgos pa'i phyir dang / yo ga dang rnal 'byor bla med pa rnams sngar dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i dus su rigs lnga'i sdom pa thob la ma nyams pa yod kyang mngon rtogs tshar re'i 'gor yang rigs lnga'i sdom gzung bya dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes don zhags yid ches khungs btsun du gsungs pa'i gso sbyong nges par blangs dgos pa'i tho rengs snga bar khrus byas nas langs la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

se gol bcas rdo rje bsdu bas phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar la tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su phyag 'tshal bcas shur mas/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /dang po me tog phog pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po/ /bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing / /de bzhin gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dag pa'i 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu/ /dge bas ngan song las grol zhing / /gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i/ /zhi gyur chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ /bslab pa la dag rab tu gus/ /zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing / /dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku gyur pa ni thams cad la/ mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' ba/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa/ /rgyal ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can/ /zhal stong thugs rje can dang ldan/ /phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyob/ /gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gzhan gyi mi thub la sogs pa/ sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la/ /bdag nyid gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdung bdun de bzhin gshegs pa bcu/ /rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams dang / /drang srong rig 'dzin grub rnams la/ /lus ngag yid kyi phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan pa srung mdzad bgegs dpung 'joms/ /gzhan gyi mi thub stobs po che/ /legs nyes bstan 'dzin dam tshig can/ /legs ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha dog ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /mthu dang sde dang zhon pa bcas/ /thabs dang snying rje 'jig rten kun/ /skyong mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyis/

/lus btud pa yi rnam kun du/ /mchog tu dad pa'i phyag 'tshal lo/ /bzhengs mu nas 'dur gdangs bcas/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na/ /dus gsum gshegs pa mi yi seṅge kun/ /bdag gis ma lus de dag thams cad la/ /lus dang ngag yid dang bas phyag bgyi'o/ /bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba thams cad yid kyi mngon sum du/ /zhing gi rdul snyed lus rab btud pa yis/ /rgyal ba kun la rab tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag /de dag chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa/ /thams cad rgyal ba dag gi gang bar mos/ /de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams/ /dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing / /bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod/ /me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang / /sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang / /mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /de nas slob dpon gyi rdor dril gzhan rnams phyi mchod rol dung sgang dung gnyis dung gsal bcas shlau ka gnyis rol mo'i sbugs la 'gro/ na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang / /phye ma'i phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang / /bkod pa'i khyad par 'phags pa'i mchog kun gyis/ /rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi/ /mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba/ /de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos/ /bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis/ /rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod pa bgyi/ /de nas phyag bya rnams bzhag thal sbyar me tog bcas tsog pur 'dug la/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni/ /lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid kyis kyang / /sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras/

/rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang / /'gro ba kun kyi bsod nams gang la yang / /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rang / /gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma rnams/ /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes/ /mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la/ /'khor lo bla na med pa bskor ba bskul/ /myang ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la/ /'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir/ /bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs pa yang / /bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol ba bgyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang / /rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi/ /dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa/ /thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /me tog 'thor zhing phyag gcig bcas/ yang tsog pur thal mo sbyar la shur ma bcas/ phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / /com ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rta cang shes lta bu/ glang po chen po/ bya ba byas shing / byed pa byas pa/ khur bor ba/ rang gi don rjes su thob pa/ srid pa kun tu sbyor ba/ yongs su zad pa/ yang dag pa'i bka' legs par rnam par grol ba'i thugs/ legs par rnam par grol ba'i shes rab can de dag gis sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med par bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir dang / gso sbyong sdom pa yang dag par mdzad pa de bzhin du/

bdag rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du sems can thams cad kyi don gyi phyir dang / phan par bya ba'i phyir dang / grol bar bya ba'i phyir dang / nad med pa bya ba'i phyir dang / mu ge med par bya ba'i phyir dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang / bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i phyir dang / gso sbyong sdom pa yang dag pa blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes tshar gsum/ yang shur mas/ deng nas srog gcod mi bya zhing / /gzhan gyi nor yang blang mi bya/ /'khrig pa'i chos kyang mi spyod cing / /rdzun gyi tshig kyang mi smra'o/ /skyon ni mang po nyer bstan pas/ /chang ni yongs su spang bar bya/ /khri stan mthon po mi bya zhing / /de bzhin dus ma yin pa'i zas/ /dri dang phreng ba dang ni rgyan/ /gar dang glu sogs spang bar bya/ /ji ltar dgra bcom rtag tu ni/ /srog gcod la sogs mi byed ltar/ /de ltar srog gcod la sogs spangs/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /sdug bsngal mang gyur 'jig rten 'di/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod/ oṃ a mo gha shī la saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra bha ra bha ra mahā buddha satwa/ padma ni bhu ṣi ta bhū ta/ dha ra dha ra sa manta a ba lo ki te hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes nyer gcig dang / tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi sha dhe bi sha dhe/ bai ra bai ra/ badzra dha ri ni bhandha bhandha oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ druṃ bhandha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ nyer gcig bzlas/ khrims kyi tshul khrims skyon med cing / /tshul khrims rnam par dag dang ldan/ /rlom sems med pa'i tshul khrims kyis/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin rdzogs shog /badzra muḥ se gol bcas bsdu rgya phyir bstan bya/ tshogs zhing rnam par gnas su gshegs par gyur/ dpung bzang las/

gso sbyong gi sdom pa dang ldan pas las la 'jug pa bshad cing / dkyil chog 'di dang nam mkha'i mtshan can gyi gzungs grangs lnga'i zin bris su gso sbyong thog mar bshad pa sogs kyi dgongs pa bzhin gyis bris so/ /dkar cha bzhi mdzad na 'dir mdzad thal sbyar shur mas/ oṃ dus gsum bde gshegs sprul pa'i sku/ /gzhan gyi mi thub dral shul che/ /stobs ma chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ma chen mo gzi brjid can/ /dkar mo chen mo stobs chen mo/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba gos dkar mo/ /'phags ma sgrol ma khro gnyer can/ /rgyal ba'i rdo rje phreng zhes grags/ /padma mngon mtshan rdo rjes mtshan/ /gzhan gyi mi thub phreng ba can/ /rdo rje'i mkhar rnams 'joms pa mo/ /zhi ba lha rnams kyis mchod ma/ /gzugs gzhi gzi brjid chen mo can/ /'phags ma sgrol ma stobs chen mo/ /rdo rje lu gu brgyud gzhan dang / /rdo rje gzhon nu rigs 'dzin ma/ /lag na rdo rje rig ser phreng / /le rgan rtsi dang rin chen ma/ /snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags/ /rnam par 'gyings ma'i rdo rje dang / /gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ma/ /rdo rje gros dang dkar mo dang / /padma can dang zla 'od dang / /sangs rgyas dpal dang de bzhin spyan/ /rdo rje nyi ma'i 'od dang ni/ /de bzhin zla ba rdo rje 'dzin/ /phyag rgya'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rang phyag na rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis sngon 'gro gtor ma dkar dmar gnyis/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shudha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bighnan na mas sarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/

lan gsum thal mo sbyar la shur mas/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten na dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyun du zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lan gcig phyir 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten na yang dag pa song ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha'i drang srong dmod pa 'dor ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /tshangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan drag po dka' thub bzlog pa'i bdag po dang lhan cig pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan nag po chen po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs par byed pa dur khrod na gnas pa ma mo'i tshogs kyi phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /padma'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen rigs/ nor bu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /las kyi rigs/ glang po'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /padma'i rigs/ gzhon nu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu'i rigs/ klu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sman gyi bla zer ba 'di ma dag ste/ rgya dper gu ru baiḍūrya zer ba yod/ bod skad du bla mar gsungs/ sman gyi bla baiḍūrya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sā la'i dbang po me tog kun tu rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/

/shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rin chen tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spyan rgyas pa utpa la'i gsung gi tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyi mi thub ma zhes bya ba phyir bzlog pa chen mo 'dis 'byung po'i gdon thams cad tshar gcod pa/ gzhan gyi rig sngags gcod pa/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba las bzlog pa/ sems can bcings pa thams cad grol ba/ sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad bzlog pa/ gdon brgyad khri bzhi stong 'jigs par byed pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dga' bar byed pa/ gza' chen po brgyad 'jigs par byed pa/ dgra thams cad bzlog pa/ ma rung pa dang sdang ba dang / rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ dug dang / mtshon dang / me dang chu las sgrol ba ste/ rig sngags cho ga 'di sbyar ba bya'o/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la rig sngags grub par gyur cig grub byed kyi gdon kyi rigs/ 'byung po'i tshogs gang su dag sa la rgyu ba rnams dang / lha'i gdon/ nam mkha' la rgyu ba rnams dang / dud 'gro'i gdon/ chu la rgyu ba rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / 'thab rtsod kyi gdon/ lha ma yin rnams dang / rig sngags 'chang ba nyi shu rtsa gcig rlung lha rnams dang / bya khyung / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / rgyal chen rigs bzhi/ dri za rnams dang / mi'am ci rnams dang / sa bdag lto phye/ lto phye rnams dang / sha za rnams/ srin po rnams dang / yi dwags rnams dang / nag mi bcu gcig sha za rnams dang 'byung po rnams dang / gshin rje dang nag mo mtshan mo/ grul bum rnams dang / srul po rnams dang / lus srul po rnams dang / skam mdze'i rigs/ skem byed rnams dang / smyo byed rnams dang /

kho'i grib ma sogs tsam lus ma 'ju/ grib gnon rnams dang / snying mi dran smugs byed/ brjed byed rnams dang / 'on byed/ gnon po rnams bdag la nyon cig 'byung po'i tshogs gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams dang / mdangs 'phrog pa rnams dang / mu stegs kyi sgra kha shed kyi rtul nas sa bon smin byed/ zas su mngal za ba rnams dang / dus thams cad du/ zas su khrag za ba rnams dang / sring mo bzhi'o/ /zas su zhag za ba rnams dang / gnod sbyin srin mo/ /zas su sha za ba rnams dang / mig log pa'i/ zas su tshil za ba rnams dang / bcud thams cad/ zas su rkang za ba rnams dang / skyes ma thag shi ba/ zas su btsas pa za ba rnams dang / dbugs za ba/ zas su dbugs 'phrog pa rnams dang / bsngos pas tshim pa/ zas su gtor ma za ba rnams dang / me tog gi zas su phreng ba za ba rnams dang / tsandan/ zas su dri za ba rnams dang / rlangs pa za ba/ zas su bdug pa za ba rnams dang / phreng ba ma yin pa/ zas su me tog za ba rnams dang / shing thog zas su 'bras bu za ba rnams dang / phye za ba/ zas su lo thog za ba rnams dang / byang chen snying po rgyud chen nas las dngos sbyin bsreg rgyas pa zhes bya ba gsungs so/ /zas su sbyin bsreg za ba rnams dang / gling bar gyi mun nag na gnas pa/ zas su rnag za ba rnams dang / zas su phyi sa za ba rnams dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su lhag ma za ba rnams dang / zas su mchil ma 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su snabs za ba rnams dang / glang po'i kha chu/ zas su ngar snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang / zas su skyug pa za ba rnams dang / khu ba dang bshal chu/ zas su gtor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba rnams dang / lus ngag yid gsum mi dge ba bcu bcad/ sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams bdag la nyon cig

rig sngags chen mo 'di sgrub par bya'o/ /spos dang me tog dang / bdug pa dang gtor ma yang sbyin no/ /gtor ma dang mchod pa 'dis mgu bar gyis la bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la/ sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / dral shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams dang / gzi brjid 'phrog pa'i gdon thams cad dengs shig slob dpon sogs kyi rdor dril gsor dkrol/ rol mo drag rol drag dung bzhi rgyun bzhin/ gtor ma phyir dor/ rol mo'i sbugs la sngags ni/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi/ bhandha bhandha/ badzra pā sha ma ma sarba duṣṭan bighnan bi na ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ a si tā na larka pra bhā sphu ṭa/ bi kā bi tā ta pa tre/ dzwa la dzwa la/ khā da khā da/ dha ra dha ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ tshindha tshindha/ bhindha bhindha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo gha phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta phaṭa/ ba ra da phaṭa/ ba ra pra da phaṭa/ pra tyaṃ gi ri ti phaṭa/ a su ra bi dra ba ka phaṭa/ ces brjod de nas mtshams bcad pa bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma chen mo'i bkas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / lha'i gdon rnams dang / klu'i gdon rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang / rlung lha'i gdon rnams dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon rnams dang / dri za'i gdon rnams dang / mi'am ci'i gdon rnams dang / lto phye chen po'i gdon rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / srin po'i gdon rnams dang / yi dwags kyi gdon rnams dang /

sha za'i gdon rnams dang / 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / grul bum gyi gdon rnams dang / srul po'i gdon rnams dang / lus srul po'i gdon rnams dang / sha ba'i lus skam nas 'chi ba/ skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang / smyos byed kyi gdon rnams dang / lus tshad sems khar gnod/ grib gnon gyi gdon rnams dang / brjed byed kyi gdon rnams dang / longs spyod lus la gnod/ gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang / lha mo/ nam gru'i gdon rnams dang / glang gi mgo can/ gshin rje'i gdon rnams dang / 'dab chags kyi mgo can/ bya'i gdon rnams dang / ma mo'i pho nya/ ma mo dga' ba byed pa'i gdon rnams dang / 'gro ba'i don/ kun tu 'gro ba'i gdon rnams dang / yud tsam na bar byed pa'i gdon/ tsher ma gdon pa'i gdon rnams dang / nad rigs dgu la sogs/ rim nyin gcig pa rnams dang / nyin gnyis pa rnams dang / nyin gsum pa rnams dang / nyin bzhi pa rnams dang / nyin bdun pa rnams dang / 'phred la rtag tu 'choms/ rtag pa'i rims rnams dang / shin tu drag po 'joms su rung / rims mi zad pa rnams dang / rims ldang dub pa rnams dang / rlung las gyur pa rnams dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams dang / bad kan las gyur pa rnams dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa rnams dang / rims nad thams cad dang / klad pa na ba dang / zhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga chus pa dang / mig na ba dang / sna nad dang / kha nad dang / mgul nad dang / snying nad dang / kog ma'i lha gor na ba dang / rna ba na ba dang / so na ba dang / snying na ba dang / rtsib logs na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang / lto ba na ba dang / sked pa na ba dang / chu so na ba dang / rje ngar na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang / rkang pa na ba dang / yan lag na ba dang / nying lag na ba dang / rims dang / shu ba dang / g.yan pa dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / mdze dang / phol mig dang / bas ldag dang / me dbal dang / g.yan pa dang / lhog pa dang /

skem pa dang / skrag pa dang / dbyig dug dang / dug sbyar ma dang / byad dang me dang chu dang / me nges dang / dgra dang / gnod pa dang / dus ma yin pa 'chi ba dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa de dag thams cad kyi rig sngags 'ching bar bgyi'o/ /gzi brjid 'phrog par bgyi'o/ /gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad gcad par bgyi'o/ /gdon thams cad bzlog par bgyi'o/ /gdugs dkar mo rdo rje gtsug tor phyir bzlog pa chen mo 'di dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad du gnod pa thams cad srung ba bgyi'o/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad zhes bya ba la srung du gsol/ lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig swāhā/ yug gcig ston la gcig gi mthar rdor dril gsol dkrol rol mo drag rol drag dung bzhi/ gtor ma dor ba dang sbugs kyi sngags ni/ oṃ ṣṭoṃ bhandha bhandha badzra ma ma rakṣa rakṣa badzra pa ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badzra pa ṇi bandha bandha/ badzra pā sha ma la sarba duṣṭaṃ bhighnān bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ a si tā na lārka pra bhā sphu ṭa bi kā si ta ta pa tre/ dzwa la dzwa la/ khā da khā da/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ tshindha tshindha/ bindha bindha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo gha phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta phaṭa/ ba ra da phaṭa/ ba ra pra da phaṭa/ pra tyaṃ ya gi ri ri phaṭa/ a su ra bi dra ba ka phaṭa/ de nas rnga rol sogs bzhag mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhāddho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ oṃ dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas kyi bye brag ji snyed yod pa thams cad rang bzhin stong pa/

rnam pa mchod yon la sogs pa mchod rdzas so sor snang ba/ ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed nus pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung ltar bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bskor nas mthar se gol bya/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū su ra su ra a warta a warta ya hoḥbadzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ de nas mchod yon sogs so so'i phyag rgya/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra a lo ke༞ oṃ badzra ghandhe༞ oṃ badzra nai wi dye༞ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐/ 'dir slob dpon gyis dril bu rgyun chags rdo rje snying khar gzhan rnams kyis mchod rol/ dung sgang dung gnyis dung gsal bcas mchod pa'i sprin gzungs ni/ na mo ratna tra ya ya/ na mo bha ga wa te badzra sa ra/ pra mardha ni/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā badzre/ ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā bi dye badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bho dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ pra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma a ba ra ṇa bi shwa dha na badzre swāhā/ tshar gcig dharma ra ṇi med byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag chen po'i thog drangs zhes nang don skabs thob mdzad/ bdag gzhan gyi skabs su 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/

chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid/ drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun༞ gnyis pa nas bzung / bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la༞ chos la༞ dge 'dun la༞ zhes nyer gcig brjod/ de nas shur mas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub ma thob bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis bsgom bzlas bgyis pa'i bsod nams 'di dag gis/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas myur du 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ slob dpon tsaṇḍa go ma'i rang skad cig gi lha mo bskyed pa'i oṃ gyi 'od zer zhes gsungs pas/ rang bcom ldan 'das mar gsal ba'i snying ga'i dbus su paṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri ma med pa'i shel ltar dkar zhing gsal ba'i oṃ yi ge de las 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can 'khor bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes se gol bcas rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ thal mo sbyar la shur ma bcas/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can/ /zhal stong thugs rje'i spyan dang ldan/ /phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyobs/ /gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal/ /gzhan gyi mi thub la sogs pa'i/ /sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la/ /bdag nyid gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdung bdun de bzhin gshegs pa bcu/ /rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang dang / /drang srong rig 'dzin grub rnams la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /bstan pa srung mdzad bgegs dpung 'joms/

/gzhan gyi mi thub stobs dang ldan/ /legs nyes stang 'dzin dam tshig can/ /legs ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kha dog ldan zhing 'od dang ldan/ /mthu dang sde dang gzhon par bcas/ /thabs dang snying rjes 'jig rten kun/ /skyong mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pad skor sngon 'gro'i so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā pa tre sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra a lo ke pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra ghandhe tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ mchod pa'i sprin gzungs dang mchod rol med/ zhabs bsil dkyil chog 'dir mi 'byung yang / gzhan du 'byung bas kha bskangs pa la nyes pa med do/ /de nas thal mo sbyar la shur mas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/zhes lan gsum bsdu rgya phyir bstan se gol bcas/ badzra muḥtshogs rten gyi dkyil 'khor rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par gyur/ tshad med bzhi ni/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par bya/ sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar bya/ sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar bya/ bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang nye ring mtha' dag dang bral nas chags med pa'i ngang la sems btang snyoms par bya/ tshar gcig bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /oṃ shyu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems yi ge oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ 'grel pa las gtso mo 'di rnams kyi zhal phyag rnam gzhag gsungs pa med do/ /gdugs dkar oṃ gyis mtshan pa de las kyang 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas bdag nyid yul 'khor srid bzang dang bcas pa khebs pa'i gdugs dkar po bsnams pa rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sa skya pa'i phyag len bla ma gong ma rnams kyis gsungs pa gzhir bzhag pa yin phyis 'grel pa nas bcu bdun ma'i skabs gzhan gyis mi thub ma bskyed par bshad/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'o/ /yang na/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar can sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba zhal gsum ma/ phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar po zhi ba'i zhal/ g.yas zhal sngon mo drag po'i zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/

rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ lha rdzas kyi dar sna tshogs kyi na bza'i stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs gsol ba/ phyag g.yas dang po gdugs dkar po rin po che'i tog gis spras pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na lcags kyu/ bzhi pa na mda'/ g.yon gyi dang po na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan/ gnyis pa na rdo rje dkar po/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ khros pa'i lta stangs dang bcas pas ma rung pa rnams 'jigs par byed pa de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par aḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i steng du zla ba la oṃ dkar po de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo la 'khor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha'i khams su oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ bsdu rgya nang bstan se gol bcas pad skor sngon 'gro'i so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra a lo ke pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra ghandhe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ mchod rol med/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ yang / oṃ las 'od 'phros dbang gi lha dpag tu med pa badzra sa mā dza/

se gol bcas rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke/ ghandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ gis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i gang ba thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yi/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrīḥhūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag sngags dang phyag rgya dang / ting nge 'dzin la dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud/ rigs thams cad kyi bdag po rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu rgyan dbang gi lha rnams kyang rigs thams cad la thim par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri bā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra a lo ke pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra ghandhe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril gzhan rnams kyis mchod rol/ dung sgang dung gnyis dung gsal bcas/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te badzra sa ra pra mardha ni ta thā ga ta ya ar ha te samyaksaṃ buddha ya/

tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre ma hā te dzo badzri/ ma hā birya badzri/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ pra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma a ba ra ṇa bi shwo dha na badzre swāhā/ rol mo sogs bzhag mchod pa bsdus nas mchod pa rnam lngas mchod gsungs kyang / 'gor chu gnyis dang / mjug tu rol mo sbyar ba bla ma'i man ngag yin no/ /de nas rdor dril 'dzin pas gdangs bcas/ bde gshegs thugs rje'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing / /bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed phyir bzlog cing / /bde chen 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bde gshegs gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dril bsil bcas/ rdor dril bzhag lha sku me long gi gzugs brnyan nam/ lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa dbang po'i gzhu ltar gyur/ lha mo'i thugs kha'i oṃ yig gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba de dag las/ 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi don byas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi 'phrin las ma lus pa bsgrub/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi thugs rjes byin brlabs nus pa ma lus pa bsdus nas rang nyid la thim par gyur/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni 'ur 'don bcas/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi shu dhe bi shu dhe/ bai ra bai ra badzra dha ri ṇi/ bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ druṃ bhandha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas la so so'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra a lo ke pra tītstsha ye swāhā/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra ghandhe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril gzhan rnams kyis mchod rol/ dung sgang dung gnyis dung gsal bcas/ mchod pa'i sprin gzungs ni/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te badzra sa ra tra ma dha ni/ ta thā ga ta ya arha te samyaksaṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā bi ya badzre ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ tra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha na badzre swāhā/ dharma ra ṇi med/ rnga rol bzhag rdor dril thogs la gdangs bcas/ bde gshegs thugs rje'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing / /bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed phyir bzlog cing / /bde chen 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bde gshegs gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dril bsil bcas rdor dril bzhag 'dir gal te bum bskyed dgos na de'i tshul ni/ bum pa dung chos rdor gzungs bcas rgyun bzhin bshams la ngag tu/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hrīḥlas padma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ baṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lto ba yangs pa/ mchu 'phyang ba/ mgrin pa ring ba kha khyer dang ldan pa btsal ba dang nag po med pa mgrin pa ras dkar po zung gis dkris pa/ de'i nang du oṃ tapte tapte ma hā tapte swāhā/ lha'i dal 'gro'i chu yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ rin po che lnga/ sman lnga/ 'bru lnga/ dri lnga/ snying po lnga rnams kyis yongs su gang zhing oṃ kalpa brikṣa ye swāhā/

dpag bsam shing gi kha brgyan pa steng du gdugs dkar po phub par gyur/ bum pa'i nang du bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje/ rdo rje dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ bgegs kyi rgyal po bi nā ya ka gdan du bting ba/ sku mdog sngon po sangs rgyas lnga'i cod paṇa can/ rdo rje'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /me'i phung po'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyag na rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha tshogs badzra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ badzri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ dbang bskur sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'i dbu brgyan/ pad bskor sngon 'gro'i so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi a lo ke pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi gandhe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril gzhan rnams kyis mchod rol dung sgang dung gnyis dung chos bcas/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badzra sa ra pra ma dha ni/ ta thā ga ta ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā bidya badzre ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ pra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swāhā/ dharma ra ṇi med/ rol mo sogs bzhag rdor dril gdangs bcas/ lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bdag po ste/ /log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i/

/bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzungs thag bzung la rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la brten nas song bas thugs rgyud bskul nas sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi bandha bandha/ badzra pā sha ma ma sarba duṣṭaṃ bighnan bi na ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ bzlas pa 'phreng 'khor de nas dung chos kyi chu la/ oṃ badzra u da ka hūm̐/ lan bdun bzla/ gzungs thag bsdus/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas mchod yon ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badzra pā ṇi arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā/ dung chos kyi mchod yon bum par blug stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas me tog ji snyed yod pa kun/ /bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badzra pā ṇi puṣpe pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐/ stong gsum 'di'am stong gsum gzhan dag na/ /lha rdzas bdug spos ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /bcom ldan bum pa'i lha la bdag 'bul na/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ badzra pā ṇi dhū pe pra tītstsha āḥhūm̐/ mar me sogs mchod pa gzhan mi dgos/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas bgegs thams cad bzlog par mdzod badzra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i chur gyur/ zhes so/ /zhes pa'ang kun blos bris/ de nas spro na/ 'di nas bzung sta gon bya'o/ /'di bar 'khor lo sgrub mkhan ma yin pa gtong mi dgos/ 'khor lo la bgegs dang mi shes sdig pa'i sbyang ba rnams byas la/ a mṛ tas sangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad nyis rim de'i phyi la mu khyud nyis rim rdor rwa me ri dang bcas pa'i bskor ba/

de'i steng gi yig 'bru rnams oṃ las gdugs dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa de yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma'am/ zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ gang rung du bskyed la sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs la ye shes spyan drangs nas bgegs bskrad mchod bstim/ sangs rgyas tshad med spyan drangs/ bgegs bskrad/ mchod bstim/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ spyan 'dren sogs byas la/ mchod bstod/ de nas ming spel bsrung bya gang yin du skyed la rdo rje nang bsdams pa las/ mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar bkug mthe'u chung gnyis gshib ste rkyang / mthe bong gshib ste brkyangs pas gung mo mnan pa'i phyag rgya/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐ dzaḥ ces pa phyag rgya dang bcas pas rang ngam sgrub bya lam yul grong la sogs pa bkug nas/ sngar bskyed pa rnams la thim par sgom ste/ de nas bsrung 'khor la bris pa'i sngags rnams spel tshig dang bcas pa bzla/ de nas rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mi nad dang phyugs nad dang yam gyi nad dang 'tshe ba dang gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad rab tu zhi bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ ji ltar gsol ba btab pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa dgyes nas bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i bar chad thams cad srung shing byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi sku de nyid zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo bris pa'i rnam par gyur/ de'i mtshan dang dpe byad rnams zhu nas dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ger gyur nas bris pa'i 'khor lo'i lte rtsibs mu khyud sogs la gnas par gyur/

ces brjod la mchod/ mnyam med mas bstod/ brtan bzhugs kyi tshig brjod/ ye dharma dang bkra shis kyi tshig brjod la/ rab gnas legs par byas pa'i bsrung ba de nyid rgyal mtshan gyi spyi bo'i nang du rlan la sogs pa'i mi gnod par byas la bzhugs/ tog la lha mo'i sku yod na zhal rang nyid phyogs la blta/ rten sku med na/ dzambha na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ/ ces bris pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs ngos rang la bstan la bzhag de lta bu'i rgyal mtshan dgu'am lnga la sogs pa 'byor pa dang bstun te/ stegs mdzes par maṇḍal padma 'dab brgyad rgyal mtshan gyi grangs dang mthun pa byas pa'i steng du rgyal mtshan bzhugs su gsol/ de'i mthar nyer mchod lnga la sogs pa ci 'byor dang gtor ma bdun bshams/ gzhan yang 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams kyang sta gon bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon rnams bzhengs nas zhwa gyon la/ las slob kyis sbyang ba'i chas rnams phyag len bzhin bshams la/ dpon slob rnams kyis lag g.yas pa skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba bighnan na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ga te bhyo bi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta swāhā/ zhes se gol gyi sgra bya/ de lta bu lan gsum byas la zhi bas sbyangs/ de bzhin du ting lo dang chang bu bskor ba dang bstun la rdo rje sor zhing / oṃ badzra pā ṇi bhandha badzra pā sha ma ma sarba du ṣṭaṃ bighnan bi nā ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyi phyed ma'i skabs ltar sbyangs/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma gdugs dkar mo can gyi sgo nas mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan rab tu gnas par byed pa dang / bde ba mchog gi lam la bar du gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig

rang gi snying kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo me ltar 'bar ba ye shes kyi khro tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ se gol bcas rdo rje bsdu'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs zhes pa'i rjes su drag dung gur drag mtshams gcod kyi 'go bzhin/ rol mo sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ gsum bteg de nas sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ sogs yun ci ring / de nas phar ge sbraṃ gcig 'pher gyi gsum byas/ phar med kyi sbraṃ 123byas 123byas/ shlau ka gcig la hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin ma'i dbyangs rol bum 'dren bcas/ hūm̐/ ye shes bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad sreg /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag pags can/ /can la rnga brda la rol mo len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas/ 123byas gcig de nas 'dur shur gang rung gi log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo gzhug su 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyi gshegs su gsol/ /gshegs la rnga brda/ pus mo gnyis gnas la rol mo sbraṃ 123/ 12 3chems brdungs dung sgang dung gsal med/ chems brdung sbugs kyi sngags la/ oṃ badzra kro dha ra dza sa pa ri wa ra e hye hi sa ma dza/ padma ka lya satwaṃ/ de nas rol mo sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas 123byas/ de nas rol mo rnams bzhag la mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ arghaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ ne wi dye/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ shlau ka gcig ma'i dbyangs rol hūm̐ 'dren bcas/ hūm̐ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing / /thabs la mkhas pa'i 'jigs byed skur ston pa/ /khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /la rnga brda la rol chen sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas 123byas 1 de nas 'dur shur gang rung gi ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang /

/sku yi cha lugs za byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra/ /ma lus dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol bar ston mdzad cing / /sdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug gsum brtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ /dpal bo'i stangs bstab brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/ /nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gsum sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gtum chen dus mtha'i gzi brjid me ltar 'bar/ /glog stong rgyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngams pa'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong bzhin sgrog /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra tshar gcig gi phyag la rnga brda tshal bstod gnyis la rol mo re re/ sbraṃ 123/ 123che gcig de nas rnga rol bzhag rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad phyag rgya dang bcas/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang / rje btsun bla ma rnams kyis bden pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bden pa dang / dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyis bden pa dang / bden pa'i byin brlabs kyi ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas/ rgyal mtshan rab tu gnas pa byed pa dang / bde ba mchog gi lam la bar tu gcod par byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas/ des tshims par gyis la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig

gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ro/ /slob dpon gyis rdor dril sor dkrol/ yungs dkar gzhan ma rnams kyis 'bru phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad la brab cing las slob kyis gu gul phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad la gdugs la 'di'i skabs rol mo drag rol drag dung bzhi'i sbugs la sngags ni/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi bandha bandha badzra pā sha ma ma/ sarba duṣṭhaṃ bighnan bi na ya ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang zhes pa nas 'di'i bar lan gsum dgos/ mchod g.yog pa'i mdun du til/ g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu bzhag til mchod g.yog pa'i lag mthil gnyis su blug la rten la kha phyogs te lag g.yas pas g.yas dang / g.yon pas g.yon du bskor gnyis gshib la/ g.yas g.yon du bskor zhing / mthar lag pa bsnol te g.yas kyi me dang g.yon gyi chu sngags dang bstun te dor/ de bzhin du lan gsum bya ste/ g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsregs/ g.yon du chus bkrus par bsam la/ dpon slob rnams kyis ngag tu/ bdag dang yon bdag gi gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa rnams snying khar yi ge kaṃ nag po'i rnam par gnas par/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas thon pas mdun gyi til la thim pa de nyid/ g.yas su ye shes kyi mes bsregs cing / g.yon du rgya mtsho'i chus bkrus par gyur/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmin ku ru swāhā/ zhes sngags lan gsum brjod cing mchod g.yog pa'i chu de'i khar me de cung zad blugs te rgya mtsho chen por dor bar bsam la/ phyi rol du gtor/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ bdag dang yon bdag gis gtso byas sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig

ces brjod/ de nas las slob kyis sku phyis phrag pa g.yon la bkal/ lag pa g.yon pas me long rten phyogs la bstan cing / khrus gsol bar bsam la/ dpon slob rnams kyi rdor dril 'dzin pa'i gdangs bcas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /dril bsil bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /dril bsil/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs pa bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mo bcas pa du mas sku 'khrus gsol/ /dpon slob kyi dril bsil/ gzhan ma rnams kyis mchod rol dang / dung sgang dung gcig dung gsal med/ de nas las slob kyi sku phyis phrag pa nas blangs la/ dkyil 'khor la phyis pa'i tshul bya zhing / dpon slob rnams kyis/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bsgos pa'i sku 'phyi'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.ā kā ya bi shwa dha ni swāhā/ dpon slob rnams rdo rje dbus mdun rgyab g.yon/ de nas las slob kyis chu de bum pa'i nang du blugs la rgyal mtshan la kha phyogs te/ dpon slob rnams kyis gdangs bcas/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa/ /gtong ba dri yi legs bsgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o/ /dril bsil/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ /khrims 'chal dri ma 'joms mdzad pa/ /tshul khrims dri yis legs bsgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o/ /dril bsil/ oṃ sarba ta thā༞ 'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu/

/khong khro'i dri ma 'joms mdzad pa/ /bzod pa dri yis legs bsgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o/ /dril bsil/ oṃ sarba ta thā༞ 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu/ /le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad pa/ /brtson 'grus dri yis legs bsgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad cing khrus bya'o/ /dril bsil/ oṃ sarba ta thā༞ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu/ rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad pa/ /bsam gtan dri yi legs bsgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o/ /dril bsil/ oṃ sarba ta thā༞ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ /shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad pa/ /shes rab dri yis legs bsgos chu/ /khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bya'o/ /dril bsil/ chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ /bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i/ /khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā༞ dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas/ /bag chags rnam drug sbyangs nas ni/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i/ /khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ /dril bsil/ oṃ sarba ta thā༞ dri ma rnam drug dag pa yi/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ /dad pa'i bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /dril bsil/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta༞ de nas las slob kyis g.yon gyi bum pa g.yas kyi kha rgyan thogs la/ tshigs bcad re'i mtshams su bum chu 'thor zhing / de bzhin du/ dpon slob rnams kyis tshigs bcad re'i mtshams su dril bsil me tog phyogs kun tu 'thor zhing gdangs bcas/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam sbyong dri ma mi mdzad cing / /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' zhing / /khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'jug mdzad cing / /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ /khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/

/gang la bde ba mnga' mdzad des/ /khyed la bde legs༞ /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yis/ /thugs kyi 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag skyong des/ /khyed la bde༞ /gang zhig 'khor ba 'gro ba yis/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing / /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ /khyed la bde༞ /gang zhig chos kun mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la/ /gsum gtsang gtsang mas mdzad pa des/ /khyed la bde legs༞ /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa/ /phun sum tshogs don gang 'byor cing / /don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des/ /khyed la bde legs༞ /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yo zhing / /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ /khyed la bde legs༞ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa nas/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing / /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ /khyed la bde legs༞ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gsungs shing / /thub pas snyan pa gang byung des/ /khyed la bde legs༞ /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyi pham mdzad cing / /tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ /khyed la bde legs༞ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ /brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang / /'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ /khyed la bde legs sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis/ /khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa/ /don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed cag bde legs shog /khyed cag lam du bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /khyed cag kun tu bde legs shog /khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /dpon slob sogs kyis dril bsil gzhan rnams kyi mchod rol/ dung sgang dung gcig dung gsal med/

de nas rgyal mtshan la kha phyogs bzhin pas/ rdor dril bcas gdangs dang / ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /dril bsil/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /dril bsil/ oṃ sarba ta tha༞ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni/ /rol mo bcas pa du mas khrus bgyi'o/ /slob dpon sogs kyi dril bsil dang gzhan ma rnams kyis mchod rol/ dung sgang dung gcig dung gsal med/ sku phyi sogs gong bzhin/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pa'i sku phyi'o/ /oṃ hūm̐ traṃ hrīḥ.āḥka ya bi shwa dha ni swāhā/ zhes pa'i sku phyi'o/ /de nas gral la 'khod/ zhwa phud gdugs dkar du bskyed pa ni/ phyag stong spyan stong zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sogs gang yin du bskyed pa yin te/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kunḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bha wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ las gdugs dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can sku mdog gangs ri'i phung po ltar dkar ba zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba g.yas zhal sngon po g.yon zhal dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas kyi dang po na gdugs dkar po rin po che'i tog gi spras pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis pa na rdo rje/ gsum pa na mda'/

bzhi pa na dgra satwa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na rgyal mtshan/ gnyis pa na 'khor lo/ gsum pa na gzhu/ bzhi pa na zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ pad zla'i gdan la zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ khros pa'i stang stabs kyis ma rung pa thams cad 'jigs shing skrag par byed pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ hūm̐ gi gong āḥyig 'og tu zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes nas bzhengs la bcom dung dang rang bzhin nas byin 'bebs ni thog mar rol mo bcom la 'phar chen gsum phyis rjes su chems brdung yun ci ring rkang gling tshar lnga de nas mtshams gcod kyi 'phar chen gcig de nas rol mo kha sbyar/ de nas steng gi rol mo 'og gi rol mo la g.yas su bskor te kha bslang la/ steng gi rol mo'i gshog pa 'og gi rol mo'i 'go phul gyi steng cung zad brdab cing rol dpon phyi rol gra sgrig pa'i rjes su/ rol mo ba gang yod kyi'ang de bzhin du 'phar cung blangs te/ gcig nas bdun gyi bar grangs bzung ba ni chung bdun zhes pa'i dgongs pa yin la/ yang rol mo kha sbyar 'phar ma mtshams gcod kyi rol mo dang / 'di la rkang gling tshar lnga/ de nas gcig nas dgu'i bar kha sbyar 'phar brdeb ni che dgu zhes pa'i dgongs pa yin la/ yang rol sgra gong bzhin chung bdun mtshams gcod 'di la rkang gling tshar lnga/ che dgu rol sgra chung bdun mtshams gcod 'di la rkang gling mi dgos/ che gnyis rol mo sgra chung drug mtshams gcod 'di la rkang gling tshar lnga/ che gsum rol sgra chung lnga/ mtshams gcod che bzhi 'di la rkang gling tshar lnga rol sgra chung bzhi mtshams gcod che lnga/

'di la rkang gling tshar lnga/ chung gsum 'then rkang che lnga 'di la rkang gling tshar lnga/ de thod 'phar yin/ spyan 'dren tshigs rkang drug la dad ring dbyangs 'khor gsum mgo bskul dad ring bzhin/ hūm̐ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la/ /sum cu rtsa gsum gnas ris su/ /la rnga brda la rol mo len/ de nas rol mo sbraṃ 12345'di la rkang gling tshar lnga chung gsum 'then rkang 12345'di la rkang gling tshar lnga de rnams 'phar chen yin/ yang mgo bskul gong bzhin/ nad kyi skal pas zhig la khyer/ /bcom ldan shākya thub pa yis/ /la rnga brda ya la rol mo len/ de nas rol mo sbraṃ 12345'di la rkang gling tshar lnga/ chung gsum 'then rkang 12345'di na rkang gling tshar lnga/ de rnams 'phar chen yin/ yang mgo bskul gong bzhin/ srung zhing skyob pa'i las mdzad nas/ /ma mo thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /la rnga brda ma la rol mo len/ de nas rol mo sbraṃ 12345'di la rkang gling tshar lnga/ chung gsum 'then rkang 12345'di la rkang gling tshar lnga/ de thams cad 'phar chen yin/ de nas 'dur shur gang rung bcas/ de yi spyi bo'i gtsug tu nub/ /stong gsum thams cad spyan gyis gzigs/ /de la ming dang mtshan gsol na/ /gtsug tor nor bu'i gdugs dkar mo/ /sngon dus phrin las mdzad pa ltar/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig dbyings nas bzhengs/ /chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs su gsol/ /bskul lo sems can don la bskul/ /sems can don la skul gyi gshegs/ /rgyal dang chom rkun me dang chu/ /dug chen pha rol dmag dpung dang / /mu ge dgra dang lce 'bab 'jigs/ /thams cad bzlog cing gshegs su gsol/ /la rnga brda/ su gsol gnyis la rol mo re re sbraṃ 123/ 123che 1 chems brdung dung rgang dung 1 rkang gling tshar 4/ mthar sbraṃ 12zhes rol mo bzhag zhes pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ bgegs bskrad phyir 'brangs ni/

sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ rje btsun bla ma rnams kyis bden༞ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi༞ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi༞ bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyi ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin du 'brangs nas/ rgyal mtshan rab tu gnas pa byed pa dang / bde ba chen po'i lam la bar du gcod pa byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par dengs shig slob dpon gyi rdor dril sor dkrol yungs dkar gyis brab cing / gzhan rnams kyis rol mo/ drag rol drag dung bzhi/ las slob kyi gu gul gyis bdug sngags ni/ oṃ a sī tā na lārka pra bha sphu ṭa/ bi ka si tā ta pa tre/ dzwa la dzwa la/ khā da khā da/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ tshindha tshindha/ bindha bindha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo gha phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta phaṭa/ ba da phaṭa/ ba ra pra da phaṭa/ pra tyaṃ gi ri ti phaṭa/ a su ra bi dra ba ka phaṭa/ tadya thya/ oṃ a na le a na le/ bi sha dhe bi sha dhe/ bai ra bai ra/ badzra dha ra ṇi/ bandha bandha badzra pa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ druṃ bhandha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ mthar rol mo sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas 123byas/ che 1byas la rnga rol bzhag nas gral la 'khod/ de nas mchod pa so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra pa dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra a lo ke pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ sogs kyis mchod/ mchod pa'i sprin gzungs med/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ se gol dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dpon slob rnams kyi rdor dril slob dpon gyis spos 'dzin pa/ shlau ka gsum la gdangs ring bcas re re'i mtshams su rdor dril bsil spos g.yab cing / ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi zad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rje'i rnam sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin brlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yongs bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol/ /de nas gdangs bcas rdor dril spos sogs gong bzhin/ chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drangs bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs/ /chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi zad nus par ldan/ /tshur byon tshur byon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/

/shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du sku bzhugs nas/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /zhes spos rdo dril rnams bzhag la/ thal mo sbyar la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ ces pa'i phyir 'brangs nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang / chos kyi bden pa༞ dge 'dun༞ rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi༞ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden༞ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi༞ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams kyi༞ bden pa'i byin brlabs kyis ye shes sems dpa'i phyi bzhin 'brangs nas rgyal mtshan rab tu gnas pa byed pa dang / bde ba mchog gi lam la bar du gcod pa byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig slob dpon gyi rdor dril gsor dkrol/ las slob kyi gu gul gyis bdug gzhan ma rnams kyi drag rol/ drag dung bzhi/ thugs kyi sngags ni/ oṃ a si tā na lārka sphu ṭa/ bi ka bi rā ta pa tre dzwa la dzwa la/ khā da khā da/ da ra da ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ tshindha tshindha/ bindha bindha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo gha phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta phaṭa/ ba ra da phaṭa/ ba ra pra da phaṭa/ pra tyaṃ gi ri ti phaṭa/ a su ra bi dra ba ka phaṭa/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le/ a na le/ bi sha dhe/ bi sha dhe/ bai ra bai ra/ badzra dha ri ṇi/ bhandha bhandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ druṃ bhandha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas rol mo sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas 123byas che gcig oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra pa dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra a lo ke pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra ghandhe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ mchod rol dang mchod pa'i sprin gzungs med/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ yang thugs ka'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ se gol bcas rdo rje bsdus pa'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ pad skor sngon 'gro'i so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ a lo ke/ ghandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ sogs mchod rol med/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shrī hūm̐/ rigs lnga'i dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum lnga'i dbang bskur ba dang / dbang bskur rdo rje chen po zhes pa'i tshigs bcad rnams rnal 'byor bla med kyi lugs yin pas 'dir 'bri ru mi rung ngo zhes yid ches khungs btsun lags so/ /zhes dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag lus ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang / chu lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams de nyid du thim/ de nas gser sogs mig thur gyi dngul kong sogs su bkod pa'i mar dang sbrang rtsi blangs nas me long la lha'i gzugs brnyan bsgom pa'i spyan la byug cing /

slob dpon gyis mig thur phyir btab la rdo rje'am/ me long gcig nang stabs su bzung nas 'dur shur gang rung gi ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis khyod kyi ni/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib gsal/ /oṃ tsakṣuḥtsakṣuḥs manta tsakṣu bi shwa dha ni swāhā/ zhes tshar gcig de nas rab gnas kyi gdangs bcas/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang / /gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas/ /nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /zhi ba la sogs pa'i don du yon bdag sogs sems can thams cad la gzigs pa lta bur byed par gyur/ zhes tshar gsum brjod/ de nas mchod pa byin brlabs ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wā shuddha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wā shūddho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ las byung ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ oṃ dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas kyi bye brag ji snyed yod pa thams cad rang bzhin stong pa/ rnam pa mchod rdzas so sor snang ba ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed nus pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung ltar yangs shing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bskor nas/ mthar se gol bya/

oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a watta ya a watta ya hoḥbadzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra a lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ghandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas byin brlabs mchod rol dang mchod pa'i sprin gzungs med/ de nas khrus me tog spos kyi shlau ka gnyis la sbyar de gsum la thos rgyal gyi dbyangs/ de nas snang gsal nas rtags brgyad kyi bar thos rgyal ma'i gdangs bcas/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mong mi mnga' yang / /sems can nyon mongs bag chags sbyang slad du/ /rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas/ /khams gsum gnas pa'i bag chags dag gyur cig /dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed cing / /kha dog dbyibs legs mdzes pa'i me tog 'di/ /nam mkha' gang ba sems kyis mngon sprul te/ /gzhal yas khang du sprin bzhin gtibs gyur cig /tshul khrims dri ldan spos mchog dam pa 'di/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te/ /sangs rgyas zhing du spos dri ngad ldan pa'i/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig /nyon mongs dug sreg ma rig mun sel ba'i/ /shes rab gzi ldan dpal gyi sgron me 'di/ /sprin med mkha' la nyi shar ji bzhin du/ /phyogs bcu kun tu snang bas khyab gyur cig /phyogs bcu kun tu dri mchog byung gyur cig /spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang rgyal ba'i chu/ /ye shes mkha' la bdud rtsi'i char babs pa/ /mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /rgyal ba'i sku la bkres pa mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i don du lha rdzas bdud rtsi'i bshos/ /dag cing gtsang mar sbyar te 'bul lags na/ /ye shes thugs rje can gyis bzhes su gsol/ /dri chen gsung snyan rnam grol tshangs pa'i dbyangs/

/bsam gtan ngag gi bstod de gus mchod na/ /sa bcu rim gyis bgrod de thogs med cing / /tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas chos kyis rgyal po smon/ /mdzes sdug yid 'ong gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra/ /bsil byed tsandan dri dang ro brgya'i zas/ /mnyan 'khril pañtsa li ka reg na bde/ /rnam lnga'i mchod yon ji snyed mchis pas mchod/ /mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa ma lus la/ /bsam zhing yid kyis sprul te 'bul ba yis/ /'gro ba mi zad gter la longs spyod shog /lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang gdugs dkar lha tshogs la/ /bkra shis rtags brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /zhes pas mchod/ de nas bstod pa gdangs bcas shlau ka re'i mtshams su dril bsil/ bde chen dbang phyug mchog gi gtso/ /zhal gsum rtsa zhal kunda'i mdog /g.yas sngon g.yon dmar khro zhing 'dzum/ /gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdugs dkar rdo rje mda' dang ni/ /dgra satwa g.yas kyi phyag gis 'dzin/ /rgyal mtshan 'khor lo gzhu zhags pa/ /g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog gangs kyi ri ltar dkar/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs/ /'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob/ /gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bstod/ gtor ma dang po rgyal mtshan lhar bskyed la phul te/ gtor ma byin brlabs ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ tshar gsum/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i ljags hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i rdo rje 'od zer gyi sbu gu can gyis gsol bas mnyes par gyur/

lag pa rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ urga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhna daṃ ba lya dī kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul la pad skor sngon 'gro'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra a lo ke pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril gzhan ma rnams kyis mchod rol dung sgang dung gnyis dang dung gsal bcas/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te badzra sa ra/ pra marda ni ta thā ga ta ya/ arha te/ samyaksaṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre ma hā te dzo badzre/ ma hā bidya badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pā saṃ pra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma a wā ra ṇa bi shwo dha na badzre swāhā/ dharma ra ṇi med rol mo sogs bzhag bstod pa dril bsil shur ma bcas/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can/ /zhal stong thugs rje'i spyan dang ldan/ /phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyob/ /gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod tshig gi mjug la dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol/

bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas kyis bdag bcag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / yams nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad phyir bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod/ rdor dril bzhag la gnyis pa chos skyong chen po 'khor bcas dang / las gshin dang / ri bug ma rnams la 'bul khung 'di gsungs pa rnams zhwa lu ba'i sgos kyi chos skyong yin/ 'dir gur zhal la 'bul ba'i dbang du gtang na/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ ā hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ mdun gyi nam mkhar dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su padma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug sngo nag gi yu ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ zhes pa nas/ ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i dbus na hūm̐ dang bhyoḥ'i sgra sgrog pa/ zhes bar gtor bsngo bzhin/ de nas/ mgon po'i g.yas su padma nyi ma mi ro dmar ser mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du/ zhes pa nas/ lnga ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar dang / lha mo'i thugs ka nas maṃ mdun du spros pa las/ zhes pa nas/ thugs ka'i dbus su nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ 'di zhal gyi sa bon/ yaṃ maṃ tri tri bhyoḥrnams 'od 'phros 'og min rnam par snang mdzad kyi pho brang rgya gar rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas mgon po dang sum cu rtsa gsum lha mo'i mkhar sogs nas lha mo dang / ti se bsil ba'i tshal/ po ṭa la ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod/ dar lung gnyen gyi pho brang /
