gnas mchog kha'u'i brag rdzong / dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang nas/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ las mgon pho nya 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ se gol bcas rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ de nas bcom dung gsum rgyun bzhin/ bcom rol sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ 'phar chen sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ sogs kyi chems brdung yun ci rigs/ rkang gling rgyun bzhin 'phar med/ sbraṃ 1chung 3'phar chen sbraṃ sbraṃ 12byas 12sbraṃ sbraṃ sogs chems brdung yun ci rigs rkang gling rgyun bzhin/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 12byas 12tshig rkang drug la hūm̐ 'dren bcas/ srin thung gi dbyangs rol/ hūm̐ mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /gshegs shing bzhugs pa'i gnas ngan yang / /shākya'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bdag cag rnams la phan gdags phyir/ /gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol/ /la rnga brda la rol mo len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 12byas 12rkang gling rgyun bzhin nas 'dur shur gang rung bcas/ bhyo lha mo kun gshegs༞ /da lta snyigs ma༞ /gshegs༞ /shākya'i bstan༞ /bdag cag rnams la༞ /gnas 'di nyid du༞ /hūm̐ sngon tshe rdo rje 'chang gi spyan snga ru/ /gtum po khyod kyis ji ltar khas blangs ltar/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i las la spyan 'dren na/ /sangs rgya bstan pa bsrung phyir gshegs su gsol/ /hūm̐ las mgon kun༞ /da lta snyigs ma༞ /gshegs shing༞ /shākya'i bstan༞ /bdag cag rnams༞ /gnas 'di nyid༞ /gshegs la rnga brda/ su gsol gnyis la rol mo len re/ sbraṃ 123123che 1chems brdung rkang gling g.yab dar chems brdung sbugs la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ma hā ka li de wī/ ma hā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ padma kā ma la ya satwaṃ/ ces brjod/ de nas/ rol mo sbraṃ sbraṃ 12/ rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la bzhag

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā ka li de wi sa pa ri wa ra na ma/ zhes pa nas/ ba liṃ ta swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar tshar gsum/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya shā sa na/ zhes pa nas/ di na me ke na mā ra ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i bar tshar gsum/ oṃ ru ru nas/ hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ bar tshar gsum/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la ra tri ta/ zhes pa nas/ ba lya de swāhā/ lan gsum/ a li a li ma dza dzaḥ zhes pa nas/ sarba sha druṃ bighnan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum/ de nas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā ka li de wi mahā kā la tsa turmu kha sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ ghandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta aḥhūm̐/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mgon po dang / oṃ ro ru/ sogs kyi rjes su 'bru gsum btags pas lha mo dang / oṃ ma hā kā la sogs kyi rjes su 'bru gsum btags pas zhal dang / oṃ badzra kā la yakṣa/ sogs kyi rjes su 'bru gsum btags pas las mgon rnams la nang mchod phul grub ma thag rnga brdung dang bcas shlau ka gcig la mi 'gyur ma'i dbyangs hūm̐ 'dren bcas/ hūm̐ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba po/ /mgon po gri gug thod pa can/ /kha dog nag cing ro la gzhon/ /nag po che la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /la rnga brda la rol mo len sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas 123de nas 'dur shur gang rung bcas/ dpal ldan lha mo re ma ti/ /srid pa gsum la dbang sgyur shing / /'dod khams mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mchog /dus mtshan nag mo khyod la bstod/ /dpal ldan srid gsum dbang bsgyur ba/ /nag po chen po mi zad gtsigs/ /mchu 'phyang shugs che 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /drag po'i sgra sgrog khyod la bstod/ /nag po gnod sbyin yab yum dang / /pu ṭa bha ṭa ral gcig ma/ /ru 'dren sde bzhi la sogs pa'i/ /bstan bsrung 'khor dang bcas la bstod/

/dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /thub pa'i bstan pa dar ba dang / /bstan 'dzin sku tshe rab brtan cing / /'jig rten bde zhing skyid par mdzod/ /khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /'gal rkyen nad gdon kun zhi zhing / /tshe dang bsod nams rab rgyas ste/ /bsam don chos bzhin bsgrub par mdzod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dge legs la rnga brda yid la 'dod pa la tshig rol bya/ rnga rol bzhag thal mo sbyar la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral/ dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi bka' bzhin bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung ba dang / skyob pa dang / yongs su bzung ba dang / zhi ba dang bde legs su gyur pa dang / chad pa bzlog pa dang / mtshon cha rnams spong bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyis shig rjes su rol mo drag rol/ dung sgang dung / 'jog mtshams rol mo sbraṃ 12zhes bzhag de nas gsum pa legs ldan la 'bul ba ni/ de yang gtor ma byin brlabs ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tā kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wā shūddho haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ ā hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mdun du suṃ las ri rab gru bzhi pa'i steng du paṃ las padma dang / raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ nag po re re/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ legs ldan nag po mched gsum sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/

g.yas tsandan gyi beng dang / g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi phreng bas dbu la brgyan pa/ dar nag gi na bza' bcas/ rang rang gi 'khor gyis bskor bar gyur/ de rnams kyis dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa oṃ badzra sa ma dzaḥ se gol bcas rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs/ de nas bcom dung gsum rgyun bzhin rol mo bcom rol sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ/ de rnams 'phar chen/ sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ chems brdung yun ci ring / rkang gling tshar bzhi/ 'phar med sbraṃ gcig chung gsum/ 'phar chen de nas 'phar gyi sbraṃ 123byas 123chung 1234che rkang gling tshar bzhi 12345678910tshig rkang drug la hūm̐ 'dren med pa'i pu tra'i spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs/ 'og min bde chen pho brang nas/ /mgon po kun gshegs gdan la bzhengs/ /dpal ldan drag po chen po dang / /sred med bu dang nag po che/ /legs ldan mched gsum 'khor bcas rnams/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /la rnga brda la rol mo len/ rkang gling tshar bzhi/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas/ 123chung 1234che 12345678910/ de nas chems brdung rkang gling / 'jog mtshams rol mo sbraṃ 12/ rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la bzhag dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim par gyur/ rdo rje thal mo kha bye ba'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ ma hā kā la shwa ri bhyoḥ ma hā kā la duṣḍaṃ bhyoḥ ma hā kā la duṣḍaṃ bhyoḥ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ces pa lan gsum gyi gtor ma phul/ pad bskor sngon 'gro'i so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra༞ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa༞ puṣpe pra༞ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa༞ dhū pe pra༞ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa༞

ā lo ke pra༞ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa༞ gandhe pra༞ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa༞ nai wi dye pra༞ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ de nas rnga brdung shing bka' bstod shlau ka gsum la mon bu pu tra'i dbyangs rol dzar bcas tshar drug hūm̐ 'dren med pa'i/ bstan pa bsrung mdzad mthu stobs can/ /legs ldan drag po chen po ni/ /ha yi la rnga brda/ sa la rol mo len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123123dzar rgyun bzhin/ dka' thub las bzlog drag mo dang / /lhan cig pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ha yi la rnga brda/ ya la rol mo len sbraṃ sbraṃ 123/ 123dzar rgyun bzhin/ dpal ldan rdo rje nag po rdzu 'phrul can/ /legs ldan nag po sred med bu/ /ha yi la rnga brda/ ya la rol len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123/ 123dzar rgyun bzhin/ phyag rgya chen po lnga rnams kyis/ /phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ha yi la rnga brda/ ya la rol mo len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123/ 123dzar rgyun bzhin/ legs ldan nag po grong khyer ni/ /sum brtsegs 'jigs byed dur khrod na/ /ha yi la rnga brda/ ya la rol mo len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123/ 123dzar rgyun bzhin/ gnas pa ma mo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ha yi rnga brda/ ya la rol mo len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123/ 123dzar rgyun bzhin pa'i nas 'dur shur gang rung bcas/ kun kyang sku mdog mthing nag ste/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa yi/ /tsandan beng dang g.yon pa na/ /thod pa 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhabs gnyis gar gyi dor stabs kyis/ /ri rab lhun po'i steng nas brjid/ /sku la dar nag ber chen gsol/ /bdud 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /legs ldan nag po mched gsum khyod/ /sngon dus rgyal ba'i spyan sngar ni/ /dam bcas bzhin du rjes dgongs la/ /bstan pa bsrung ba'i phrin las mdzod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnom la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar dge legs la rnga brda/

yid la tshig rol bya la rnga rol bzhag thal mo sbyar la/ legs ldan nag po chen po mched gsum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi bka' bzhin du bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ srungs ba dang / skyabs pa dang / yongs su bzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur pa dang / chad pa bzlog pa dang / mtshon cha rnams spang par gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyis shig gi rjes su rol mo drag rol dung sgang dung / 'jog mtshams sbraṃ 12/ gtor ma bzhi pa byin rlabs la rgyal chen la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs de nas rnga rol 'dzin pa/ bcom dung gsum rgyun bzhin/ bcom rol sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ/ 'phar chen sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ sogs chems brdung yun ci ring 'phar med sbraṃ 1/ chung gsum/ 'phar chen sbraṃ 123byas/ 123byas che gcig hūm̐ 'dren med pa'i tshig rkang drug la yang dag don du'i dbyangs/ ri rab lhun po'i phyogs bzhi ni/ /rgyal po chen po sde bzhi ni/ /yul 'khor bsrung dang 'phags skyes po/ /spyan mi bzang dang rnam thos sras/ /btsun mo sras dang 'khor gyi tshogs/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /la rnga brda/ la la rol mo len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123/ byas 123byas che 1/ chems rdung dang dung sgang dung / ma hā rā dza tsa tur sa pā ri wā ra a karṣa ya dzaḥ 'jog mtshams rol mo sbraṃ 12/ rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la bzhag de nas rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas/

oṃ hi ta rāṣṭa ya swāhā/ oṃ bī ru dha kā ya swāhā/ oṃ bi ru pakṣa ya swāhā/ oṃ bai shrā ba ṇa ya swāhā/ sa pa ri wa ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhna daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gtor ma 'bul/ pad skor sngon 'gro'i so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ ma hā rā dza tsa tur sa pā ri wā arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ ma hā rā dza tsa tur sa pā ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ ma hā rā dza tsa tur sa pā ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ ma hā rā dza tsa tur sa pā ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ ma hā rā dza tsa tur sa pā ri wā ra a lo ke pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ ma hā rā dza tsa tur sa pā ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ ma hā rā dza tsa tur sa pā ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ ma hā rā dza tsa tur sa pā ri wā ra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ 'phrin bcol ni/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor skyong / /sku mdog dkar bas zhi ba 'grub/ /thugs rje chen pos pi wang 'dzin/ /shar phyogs dri za dbang du bsdus/ /'khor 'dir gnod pa med par mdzod/ /la rnga brda/ ya la rol mo len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas/ 123byas che gcig yang dbyangs gong bzhin gyis/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po/ /mngon spyod tshul gyi 'gro don mdzad/ /dug gsum gcod pa'i ral gri bsnams/ /lho phyogs grul bum dbang du bsdus/ /'khor 'dir gnod pa med pa mdzod/ /la rnga brda/ ya la rol mo len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas/ 123byas che 1/ yang dbyangs gong bzhin gyi/ rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang / /dbang bsdus dmar smug 'jigs pa'i sku/ /nus pa'i mthu rdzogs zhags pa bsnams/ /nub phyogs klu rnams dbang du bsdus/ /'khor 'dir gnod pa med par mdzod/ /la rnga brda/ ya la rol mo len/

sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas/ 123byas/ che 1/ yang dbyangs gong bzhin gyis/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ /che ba'i yon tan rgyas pa'i sku/ /rin chen gter dang ne'u le 'dzin/ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin dbang du bsdus/ /'khor 'dir gnod pa med par mdzod/ /la rnga brda/ ya la rol mo len sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas/ 123byas che gcig gi de nas 'dur shur gang rung gi mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar/ dge legs la rnga brda/ yid la 'dod pa la tshig rol bcas rnga rol bzhag thal mo kha sbyar la/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la/ shar phyogs dri za'i gdon las gyur pa'i nad dang / gnod pa dang / nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi ba dang / 'phags skyes pos lho phyogs grul bum gyi gdon las gyur pa'i nad dang / gnod pa dang / nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi ba dang / spyan mi bzang gis nub phyogs klu'i gdon las gyur pa'i nad dang / gnod pa dang / nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi ba dang / rnam thos sras kyis byang phyogs gnod sbyin gdon las gyur pa'i nad dang / gnod pa dang / nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad zhi ba dang / mdor na rgyal chen sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi bka' bzhin du bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung ba dang / skyob pa dang / yongs su bzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su gyur pa dang / chad pa zlog pa dang / mtshon cha rnams spang bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyis shig gi rjes rol mo drag dung sgang dung / 'jog mtshams rol sbraṃ 12zhes rnga rol bzhag gtor ma lnga pa chos skyong la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ bcom dung gsum rgyun bzhin bcom rol sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ de rnams 'phar chen sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ sogs chems brdung yun ci ring 'phar med sbraṃ gcig 'phar chen chung gsum sbraṃ 123byas 123byas che gcig chos skyong spyan 'dren shlau ka gcig hūm̐ 'dren med pa'i nag po gnod sbyin dbyangs/ phyogs bcu skyong ba zhal bzhes pa'i/ /steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /brgya byin gshin rje chu lha dang / /nor bdag dbang ldan ma yi lha/ /la rnga brda/ ya la rol mo len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas/ 123'dir 'dur shur gang rung gi srin po dang ni rlung lha dang / /sa yi lha mo bstan ma ste/ /phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor bcas yang / /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /la rnga brda/ su gsol gnyis la rol mo re re/ sbraṃ 123/ 123 che gcig chems rdung dung sgang dung sbugs kyi sngags ni/ oṃ da sha dī lo kā pā la sa pa ri wā ra arṣa ya dzaḥ 'jog mtshams rol mo sbraṃ 12rol bskor 'bebs bcas byas la bzhag de nas rdo rje thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba bskor zhing mthar se gol bcas/ oṃ ind+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ agne swāhā/ oṃ ya mā ya swāhā/ oṃ ni ri tī ye swāhā/ oṃ wa ru ṇā ya swāhā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swāhā/ oṃ i sha nā ya swāhā/ oṃ brahma ṇa ya swāhā/ oṃ sur yā ya swāhā/ oṃ tsand+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ pri thi bi bhyaḥswāhā/ oṃ na ge bhyaḥswāhā/ oṃ a su re bhyaḥswāhā/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhna daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyi gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ dā sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/

oṃ dā sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ dā sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ dā sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ dā sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra ā lo ke tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ dā sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra gandhe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ dā sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ dā sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badzra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ de nas rnga brdungs shing phur sgrub phyi rol la byed pa bzhin/ dbang po rdo rje 'chang ba'i lha/ /lha yi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /me de bsreg bya za ba'i lha/ /drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gshin rje'i be con 'chang ba'i lha/ /ma mo'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho phyogs gdon gyi tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /bden dang bral ba legs ldan lha/ /srin po'i rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /lho nub srin po'i tshogs bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /zhags pa thogs pa chu yi lha/ /tshigs bsrung gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /nub phyogs chu lha 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod cing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /phyag la rnga brda/ kyang 'tshal gnyis rol mo re re/ mtshams bcad 123/ 123che gcig yang gdangs gong bzhin gyi rnga brdung bcas/ rlung ste sreg kyang 'dzin pa'i lha/ /rig 'dzin rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /nub byang rlung lha 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gnod sbyin lag na dbyug tho thogs/ /nor bsrung gdon gyi bdag po ste/ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin 'khor bcas la/

/mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ dbang dang ldan pa 'dren pa'i lha/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /byang shar dbang ldan 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /steng gi tshangs pa chen po dang / /nyi ma zla ba gza' chen po/ /gza' dang rgyu skar bcas pa la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /'og gi klu ste sa yi bdag /sa 'dzin lag pa chen po dang / /dam tshig shes pa'i tshogs rnams la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /la rnga brda/ kyang 'tshal gnyis la rol mo re re/ mtshams bcad 123/ 123che gcig de nas thal mo sbyar la/ phyogs skyong bcu po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi bka' bzhin du bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung ba dang / skyobs pa dang / yongs su bzung ba dang / zhi ba dang / bde legs su gyur pa dang / chad pa bzlog pa dang / mtshon cha rnams spongs bar gyis shig lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig ston brgya mthong bar gyis shig gis rjes su rol mo drag rol dung sgang dung 'jog mtshams/ sbraṃ 12zhes rnga rol bzhag lag pa bsnol ba mtheb srin sbyar la mjug se gol bcas/ dā sha dika lo kā pa la sa pā ri wā ra gatstsha/ gtor ma drug pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya mjug mdzub mo bkug pa'i phyag rgya/ oṃ yul grong gnas gzhi'i bdag po sarba sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥ lag pa bde stong bskor ba mjug se gol bcas kyi phyag rgya/

oṃ yul bdag grong bdag gnas bdag gzhi bdag gnyug mar gnas pa sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhna daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul de nas rdo rje snying kha dang dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid 'bul zhing bsngo ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni spyir 'dzam bu gling bye ba phrag brgya nang na gnas pa'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo/ /ru nga ba dang phrag dog pa dang / sdod na bskul la 'gro na bshol 'debs la sogs pa'i gnod 'tshe'i bsam pa thams cad spongs/ gzhi bzang po chos ldan du skyong ba'i gnas po bzang po mdzod cig gnas mgron gyi dam tshig bsrung 'gal rkyen thams cad spongs/ mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub pa'i 'phrin las rgya chen po mdzod cig yul grong gnas gzhi'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyis bka' bzhin du/ yul phyogs 'dir mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / yams nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / pha rol gyis dmag tshogs thams cad phyir bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod cig gtor ma bdun pa sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs pa ni lag pa thal mo khog stong gi phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ swā bhā wa shuddho sarba dharma swā bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ zhes lan gsum/ gtor ma'i rdzas so so'i nyes skyon gyi dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs par gyur/ lag pa dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ bdud rtsi'i zas phun sum tshogs par gyur/

lag pa thal mo phyir bskyed mthe bong bsnol sor mo gzhan rnams so sor brkyangs pa'i phyag rgya/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum/ gang mos par gyur ba gyur/ lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs nas g.yas kyi mdzub mo sgreng ba'i phyag rgya/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ke te oṃ sambha ra sambha ra hūm̐ lan gsum/ 'dod yon la sogs thams cad la longs spyod nus par gyur/ lag g.yas rdo rje khu tshur snying khar bzhag g.yon mchod sbyin gyi snod 'ding tshul bya/ oṃ dzñā na ā wa lo ke sa manta spha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hrī da ya dzwa la ni hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum/ mgron rnams kyis so sor thob par gyur/ lag pa thal mo khong stong las rdo rje nang bsdams mthe bong gshibs ste brkyangs pa'i phyag rgya/ na maḥsarba buddha nāṃ gra he shwa re pra bha wa dza ti na maḥs manta swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ srid zhu dang yon tan dang snying rje dang lan chags kyi mgron thams cad dam tshig gi dbang gi bdag la dgongs shig sdong grogs su 'gyur zhing / sems can thams cad kyi las don ci bcol ba 'grub par gyur cig de nas gdon chen nyer brgyad spyan drangs ba ni/ de nas bcom dung gsum rgyun bzhin/ bcom rol sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ de rnams 'phar chen/ sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ sogs chems brdung yun ci rigs rkang gling g.yab dar/ 'phar med sbraṃ 1chung gsum/ 'phar chen sbraṃ 12chung 123che 12chung 123/ che 12chung 123che 1spyan 'dren shlau ka gcig la hūm̐ 'dren pa'i sho thung gi dbyangs/ mi sdug 'tshe ba'i ngang tshul can/ /gdon chen nyi shu rtsa brgyad de/ /gzi brjid 'phrog dang mdangs 'phrog pa/ /mngal dang khrag zhag sha za dang / /la rnga brda/ ya la rol mo len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 12/ chung 123/ che 12/ chung 123/ che 12/ chung 123/ che 1rkang gling g.yab dar de nas 'dur shur gang rung bcas/ tshil za rkang dang btsas pa za/

/srog 'phrog pa dang gtor ma za/ /phreng ba dri dang bdug pa za/ /me tog 'bru dang lo tog za/ /sbyin sreg phyi sa rnag za ba/ /gcin 'thung mchil ma lhag ma za/ /snabs za ngar snabs mi gtsang za/ /gtor khung babs 'thung skyugs pa za/ /de ltar gnod byed 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod pa'i gnas su gshegs su gsol/ /gshegs la rnga brda/ su gsol gnyis la rol mo re re/ sbraṃ 123/ 123che 1/ chems brdung rkang gling g.yab dar sngags ni/ e hye hi/ mthar rol mo sbraṃ 12/ zhes dang / de nas rnga rol 'dzin pas 'dur shur gang rung gis mchod 'bul ni/ gdon chen gnod byed nyer brgyad la/ /mthun pa'i mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi/ /gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang / /yon bdag bsam pa rdzogs par gyis/ /rdzogs la rnga brda/ par gyis gnyis la rol mo re re/ sbraṃ 123/ 123che 1/ chems brdungs dung sgang dung 1/ mchod rol sbugs la/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta aḥhūm̐/ mthar rol mo sbraṃ 12/ rnga brdung 'dur shur gang rung gi gzi brjid che dang gdangs gsal la/ /gzugs brnyan khrag sna brgyan pa 'bul/ mngal za ba la mngar gsum rtse/ /khrag 'thung ba la khrag sna 'bul/ /zhag za ba la zhag dang bcud/ /sha za ba la sha yi tshogs/ /tshil za ba la phyi nang tshil/ /rkang za ba la rkang mar 'bul/ /btsas pa za la bu ram dang / /shin tu sbyar ba 'di bdag 'bul/ /srog 'phrog pa la 'o ma dang / /zho dang ka ra bcas pa 'bul/ /skyugs pa za la sbrang rtsi dang / /mi gtsang za la sgog tsong dang / /la phug rgyu rkyen sbyar ba 'bul/ /gcin 'thung ba la rgun 'brum chang / /'bras chang bcud dang bcas pa 'bul/ /gtor khung nas babs 'thung ba la/ /chu la mang po bcud sbyar 'bul/ /lhag ma za la zas kun gyi/ /lhag ma bsdus la 'bul bar bya/ /mchil ma 'thung la sbrang dang bcud/ /bya mo'i sgong nga snabs za la/ /ngar sgong ngar snabs za la 'bul/ /rnag za ba la rul ba'i sha

/gtor ma za la khu ba dang / /rab tu sbyar ba'i gtor ma 'bul/ /phreng ba za la ru rakṣa/ /bo dhi tsitta la sogs 'bul/ /dri za za la ga bur dang / /bzang sman drug dang bcas pa 'bul/ /bdug pa za la sbyar spos bdug /dri dang 'bras bu bcas pa 'bul/ /sems 'phrog pa la sha khrag chang / /sgog tsong bcas pa'i gtor ma 'bul/ /me tog za la me tog rigs/ /'bras bu za la bu ram dang / /shing tog sna tshogs bcas pa 'bul/ /lo thog za la 'bru za dang / /'bras dang nas kyi snye ma 'bul/ /sbyin bsreg za la 'bru bcud dang / /'bras kyi lag zan dbul bar bya/ /rang rang mthun rdzas 'di bzhes la/ /gnod pa'i bsam sbyor zhi ba dang / /mthun pa'i bsam pa ldan par gyis/ /bde legs thams cad 'byung bar mdzod/ /mthun pa'i bsam pa la rnga brda/ bde legs thams cad la tshig rol bya la rnga rol bzhag de nas rgyal chen shugs ldan 'od kyi phyag rgya g.yon dpung par phu tshur/ g.yas khu tshur gyi 'dzub mo sgreng zhing bskor ba'i mthar se gol dang bcas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sambha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum/ de nas thal mo sbyar la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams bklas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba'i dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /'byung po'i tshogs gang su dag sa la rgyu ba rnams dang / nam mkha' la rgyu ba rnams dang / chu la rgyu ba rnams dang / lha rnams dang / klu rnams dang / lha ma yin rnams dang / rlung lha rnams dang / nam mkha' lding rnams dang / dri za rnams dang / mi'am ci rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po rnams dang / gnod sbyin chen po rnams dang / srin po rnams dang / yi dwags rnams dang / sha za rnams dang / 'byung po rnams dang / grul bum rnams dang /

srul po rnams dang / lus srul po rnams dang / skem byed rnams dang / grib gnon rnams dang / brjed byed rnams dang / gnon po rnams bdag la nyon cig 'byung po'i tshogs gzi brjid 'phrog pa rnams dang / mdangs 'phrog pa rnams dang / zas su mngal za ba rnams dang / zas su khrag 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su zhag za ba rnams dang / zas su sha za ba rnams dang / zas su tshil za ba rnams dang / zas su rkang za ba rnams dang / zas su btsas pa za ba rnams dang / zas su srog za ba rnams dang / zas su gtor ma za ba rnams dang / zas su phreng ba za ba rnams dang / zas su dri za ba rnams dang / zas su bdug pa za ba rnams dang / zas su me tog za ba rnams dang / zas su 'bras bu za ba rnams dang / zas su lo thog za ba rnams/ zas su sbyin sreg za ba rnams dang / zas su rnag za ba rnams dang / zas su phyi sa za ba rnams dang / zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang / zas su lhag ma za ba rnams dang / zas su mchil ma za ba rnams dang / zas su ngar snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su snabs za ba rnams dang / zas su mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang / zas su skyugs pa za ba rnams dang / zas su gtor khung nas 'babs pa 'thung ba rnams dang / sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa rnams bdag la nyon cig bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyi mi thub ma chen mo'i rig sngags las 'byung ba bzhin khyod rnams la me tog dang / spos dang / bdug pa yang sbyin no/ /gtor ma yang sbyin no/ /mchod gtor 'di rnams kyi mgu bar gyis la bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la zhi ba dang / bde legs su 'gyur ba dang / chad pa bzlog pa dang / dug zhi ba dang / mtshams bcad pa dang / yongs su srungs ba dang /

yongs su bzung ba dang / chad pa thams cad bzlog par mdzod cig rgyal po dang / chom rkun dang / me'am/ chu'am/ dug gam/ mi mdza' ba'am/ lam du 'gro ba'am/ lam gol bar 'gro ba'am/ gnyid log pa'am/ ra ro ba'am/ bag med pa thams cad las bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la bsrung bar gyis shig bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa dang / sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa dang / drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / lha'i gdon rnams dang / klu'i gdon rnams dang / lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang / rlung lha'i gdon rnams dang / nam mkha' lding gi gdon rnams dang / dri za'i gdon rnams dang / mi'am ci'i gdon rnams dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gdon rnams dang / gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang / srin po'i gdon rnams dang / yi dwags kyi gdon rnams dang / sha za'i gdon rnams dang / 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang / grul bum gyi gdon rnams dang / srul po'i gdon rnams dang / lus srul po'i gdon rnams dang / skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang / smyo byed kyi gdon rnams dang / grib gnon gyi gdon rnams dang / brjed byed kyi gdon rnams dang / gnon po'i gdon rnams dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang / nam gru'i gdon rnams dang / gshin rje'i gdon rnams dang / bya'i gdon rnams dang / ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon rnams dang / kun tu 'gro ba'i gdon rnams dang / tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon rnams dang / rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang / nyin gnyis pa rnams dang / nyin gsum pa rnams dang / nyin bzhi pa rnams dang / nyin bdun pa rnams dang / rtag pa'i rims rnams dang / rims mi zad pa rnams dang / rims ldang dub pa dang / rlung las gyur pa dang / mkhris pa las gyur pa dang / bad kan las gyur pa dang / 'dus pa las gyur pa dang /

rims nad thams cad dang / klad pa na ba bsal du gsol/ gzhogs phyed na ba dang / yi ga 'chus pa dang / mig nad dang / sna nad dang / kha nad dang / mgul nad dang / snying nad dang / lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang / rna ba na ba dang / so na ba dang / rtsibs logs na ba dang / rgyab na ba dang / lto ba na ba dang / sked pa na ba dang / chu so na ba dang / brla na ba dang / rje ngar na ba dang / lag pa na ba dang / rkang pa na ba dang / yan lag na ba dang / nying lag na ba dang / rims dang / shu ba dang / g.ya' ba dang / 'brum bu phra mo dang / mtshan bar rdol ba dang / mdze dang / phol mig dang / bas ldags dang / me dbal dang / g.yan pa dang / lhog pa dang / skem pa dang / skrag pa dang / dbyig dug dang / dug sbyar ma dang / byad dang / me dang / chu dang / mi nges dang / dgra dang / gnod pa dang / dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang / gzhan gyi srog 'phrog pa de dag thams cad bzlog par gyur cig gzi brjid 'phrog pa thams cad bzlog par gyur cig gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad bzlog par gyur cig gdon thams cad bzlog par gyur cig gnod pa thams cad bzlog par gyur cig gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub ma'i rig sngags chen mo'i mthus bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad gdon thams cad dang gnod pa thams cad las thar bar gyur cig swāhā/ de nas slob dpon sogs kyi rdor dril gsor dkrol/ rol mo ba rnams kyis drag rol/ rnga phyir brdungs drag dung bzhi gtor ma rdzas bcas phyir bskyal la mthar rol mo sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123/ byas/ 123/ byas/ che gcig byas la rnga rol bzhag 'di mi chung tsam la las slob kyi rgyal mtshan gyi tog la gzungs thag btags te/ de nas gzungs thag bzung ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa a wa lo ki te buddha te dzo tā se/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la/ khā da khā da/ dha ka dha ka/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ tshindha tshindha/ bhindha bhindha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/

zhes snying po/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes nye snying dang / tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bi shudhe bi shudhe/ bai ra bai ra/ badzra dhā ri ṇi bandha bandha/ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐ druṃ phaṭa/ bhandha phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ yang na/ tadya thā/ oṃ a na le a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ sarba buddhiṣṭhī na a dhiṣṭhi te/ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa bsnyen sngags dang / oṃ a si ta na lārka pra bha sphu ṭa bi ka si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la/ khā da khā da/ dha ra dha ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ tshindha tshindha/ bhindha bhindha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo gha phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta phaṭa/ ba ra da phaṭa/ ba ra pra da phaṭa/ pra tyaṃ gi ri ti phaṭa/ a su ra bi dra ba ka phaṭa/ sarba de be bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba nā ge bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba a su re bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba ma ru te bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba ga ru ḍe bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba gandhe rba bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba ghandha ta bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba kinna re bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba ma ho ra ge bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba yakṣe bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba rakṣa se bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba pre de bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba pi shā tsi bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba bhu te bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba kushmashne bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba pu ta ne bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba ku ṭa pu ta ne bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba kande bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba unmā de bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba tstsha ye bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba uṣmā te bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba ostā ra ke bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba dur laṃ ghi de bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba duṣṭe kṣe te bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba dzwa re bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba tra tya karma kā ṣodhai bhyaḥphaṭa/ ki ra ṇa pe rā ḍe bhyaḥphaṭa/ tsitstsha pre sha ka duṣitsarsha te bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba durbhukte bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba tīrthi kāe bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba shra ma ṇe bhya phaṭa/ sarba pā da ke bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba bidye dha re bhyaḥphaṭa/ dza ya ka ra mañdzu ka ra/ sarba artha pā da ke bhyaḥphaṭa/ bi dye tsa re bhyaḥphaṭa/ tsa turbha gi nī ye bhyaḥphaṭa/ sarba kau mā rī ye bhyaḥphaṭa/ bi dye rā dzi ye bhyaḥphaṭa/

ma hā pra tyaṃ gi ri ti bhyaḥphaṭa/ badzra shrī kha la ya pra gi ra rā dza ya phaṭa/ ma hā kā lā ya tri ga ṣa na masatri tā ya phaṭa/ biṣṇa nī ye phaṭa/ brahma ṇa ye phaṭa/ agni ye phaṭa/ mā hā kā li ye phaṭa/ kā la danḍi ye phaṭa/ ind+ra ye phaṭa/ ro bo dri ye phaṭa/ ko ma rī ye phaṭa/ wā rā hī ye phaṭa/ tsa muṇḍi ye phaṭa/ rā tri ye phaṭa/ ka la rā tri ye phaṭa/ ya ma daṇṭi phaṭa/ ka pā lī ye phaṭa/ a dhi mukti shma sā nā bā si nī ye phaṭa/ phyir bzlog chung ba las 'byung ba'i zhwa lu lo chen gyis zhu dag mdzad pa ltar bris/ mchog grub dang mi gcig par snang ngo zhes gzungs ring ngo / /zhes 'byung / snying po dang nye snying dang / bsnyen sngags tsho gnyis so so nas nyer gcig re 'ur 'don/ gzungs ring gsum 'ur 'don/ de nas thal mo sbyar la gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / yams kyi nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad rab tu zhi bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das ma zhes pa nas 'di'i bar lan gsum brjod pas gsol ba 'debs/ phan yon brjod pa thal sbyar bcas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba gzhan gyi mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te rim gro cher mchod pa chen po byas la grong khyer thams cad kyi sgo'am/ grong ngam/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i gnas su gzugs so/ /'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa chen mo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rim gro cher byas te btsugs na btsugs ma thag tu/ yul du zhi ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /yams kyi nad dang /

'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'grub par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas 'di bar phan yon brjod pa lan gsum brjod/ de nas rgyal mtshan la me tog gtor la zhal bsgyur ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i ye shes kyi sku de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi rnam par gyur/ zhal bsgyur 'di tshar gcig de la mchod bstod ni/ mnyam med ma'am/ yang na ngo bo bcom ldan 'das ma yin pas/ bcom ldan 'das ma gang du bskyed la/ de'i bstod pa byas kyang rung ngo / /zhes gsung pa des na rgyal mtshan de rol mo dang bcas pa'i grong dang khang pa'i nang la sogs pa thams cad bskor la/ de nas khang tho'i shar phyogs su khyer te/ der gtso mo dang legs ldan yul 'khor srung rnams la 'bul ba'i gtor ma nyer mchod bcas pa bkod pa la/ dpon slob rnams kyis pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ slob dpon sogs kyis rdor dril dkrol/ gzhan ma rnams kyis mchod rol dung sgang dung gnyis dung gsal bcas/ mchod rol gyi sbugs kyi mchod pa'i sprin gzungs ni/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badzra sa ra pra mardha ni ta thā ga ta ya/ arha te sa myaksaṃ bu ddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre mahā te dzwo badzre ma hā bidya badzre/ ma hā bodhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bhodhi maṇḍo pa saṃ pra ma ṇa badzre sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha na badzre swāhā/ dharma ra ṇi med/ de nas rnga rol rnams bzhag rdor dril 'dzin pas tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su dril bu bsil gdangs bcas/ bde chen dbang phyug mchog gi gtso/ /zhal gsum rtsa zhal kunda'i mdog /g.yas sngo g.yon dmar khro zhing 'dzum/ /gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdugs dkar rdo rje mda' dang ni/ /dgra satwa g.yas kyis phyag gis 'dzin/ /rgyal mtshan 'khor lo gzhu zhags pa/ /g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog gangs kyi ri ltar dkar/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob/ gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod la dril bsil rnams bzhag de nas rgyal mtshan phyogs tha dad du yod tshe mchod gtor 'don pa rnams de dang gyer byed pa'o/ /yang na gnas gcig nas phyogs so sor dmigs nas byed pas/ las slob kyis gtor ma dang mchod gtor rnams bshams/ de nas chab bcas dpon slob rnams bzhengs nas zhwa gyon rgyal mtshan la zhal phyogs pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gtso mo legs ldan mched gsum/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs par gyur/ gtor ma byin brlabs ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa le ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyi gtso mo dang legs ldan la/ oṃ ma hā ka la sha ri bhyoḥ ma hā ka la duṣṭi bhyoḥ ma hā ka la duṣṭaṃ bhyoḥ sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis legs ldan dang / yul 'khor bsrung la/ oṃ dhri ta raṣṭa sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhne daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis yul 'khor bsrung la 'bul/ thun mong du/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod/ mchod rol sprin gzungs med/ bstod pa ni/ shur ma tshigs bcad re'i mtshams su dril bu bsil/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can/ /zhal stong thugs rje'i spyan dang ldan/ /phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyob/ /gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bstan pa srung mdzad bgegs dpung 'joms/ /gzhan gyi mi thub stobs po che/ /legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig can/ /legs ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /margad mdog mtshungs pi wang 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang sgyur ba/ /yul 'khor srung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas dril bu chig brdung bya zhing / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ /zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/

de nas bcom rol bcom dung 'khor gsum rgyun bzhin/ bcom rol sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ/ de nas 'phar chen/ sbraṃ sbraṃ sogs chems brdungs yun ci rigs/ 'phar med kyi sbraṃ 1/ chung 3/ 'phar chen 'phar med sbraṃ 12byas 12/ sngon gyi grong khyer shlau ka gcig la hūm̐ 'dren dang bcas srin thung gi dbyangs/ hūm̐ sngon gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs ni/ /nag po chen pos 'jig pa'i tshe/ /bde gshegs sprul sku'i gtsug tor nas/ /gdugs dkar can gyi lha mor sprul/ /la rnga brda/ la la rol mo len/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 12byas/ 12/ de nas 'dur shur gang rung bcas/ gtsug tor gdugs dkar byin rlabs kyis/ /nag po chen po dam la btags/ /nag po chen po mnyes byas nas/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs brtan par byas/ /sum brtsegs pa yi mi rnams kyis/ /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad bzlog /gsum brtsegs pa yi la rnga brda/ mi mthun rkyen dang la tshig rol/ de nas 'dur shur gang rung bcas/ hūm̐ dam can sgrub mchog bdag gis kyang / /gtsug tor gdugs dkar dam can la/ /mchod dang gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi/ /mchod dang gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /grong khyer chen po sum brtsegs bzhin/ /grong khyer 'di yang srungs du gsol/ /sum brtsegs pa yi mi bzhin du/ /grong khyer 'di na gnas pa yi/ /bzhugs dang mi bzhugs thams cad kyi/ /mi mthun bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ /gzhan gyis bsgrub pa'i rig sngags bzlog /gzhan gyis 'bebs pa'i pho nya bzlog /rgyal mtshan 'di yi nus pa yis/ /shar phyogs cha 'di srungs du gsol/ /shar gyi gdon tshogs phyir bzlog cig /'byor dang bkra shis tshur gsol cig /shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor bsrung / /dri za'i tshogs dang bcas pa la/ /rgyal mtshan 'di ni gnyer du 'bul/ /srungs zhing skyobs pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /grong khyer 'di yi shar phyogs su/ /rgyal mtshan 'di ni btsugs pa yis/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/

/phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par shog /zhi rgyas dbang dang la rnga brda/ phrin las rnam bzhi la tshig rol byas la rnga rol bzhag rgyal mtshan lnga la sogs pa yod na shar phyogs su 'dzugs rgyu'i rgyal mtshan de nyid btsugs la/ dpon slob rnams kyis/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi khams rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu rgyal mtshan 'di dag la sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du de srid du sems can gyi don dpag tu med par mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ rgyal mtshan la me tog 'thor bzhin pas/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya wa datte ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ nā di ma hā shra ma ṇā ya swāhā/ sngags ni ci rigs pa bzla/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i zhes pa nas 'di bar thun lan gsum mdzad/ phun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis dril bsil/ gdangs bcas/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas padma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin/ /de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye rgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pas bkra shis phyug /mi dang lha dang lha ma yin gyi mchod pa'i gnas/

/tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /'di ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/ /mthar mchod rol dung sgang dung gnyis bkra shis la 'bud pa bzhin/ de nas lhor 'dzugs rgyu'i rgyal mtshan de nyid khyer la 'dzugs pa'i cho ga rnams brjod/ rgyal mtshan gcig las med na shar phyogs kyi de nyid lho phyogs su khyer/ de nas dpon slob rnams nub dang byang la'ang 'di'i rigs 'gre/ lho phyogs su phyin la/ gtor ma dang mchod pa rnams gong bzhin bshams la/ rgyal mtshan la zhal phyogs pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gtso mo legs ldan mched gsum/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs par gyur/ gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ swā bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swā bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba'i phyag rgya bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhne daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis gtso mo dang / oṃ ma hā kā la sha ri bhyoḥm hā kā la duṣṭi bhyoḥm hā ka la duṣṭaṃ bhyoḥs pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes las gsum gyi legs ldan dang / oṃ bi rū dha kā ya sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyoḥbi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛhne daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

zhes lan gsum gyis legs ldan dang / oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyoḥbi shwa mu ṣe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga khaṃ gṛhne daṃ ba lingta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum gyis rnam thos sras la 'bul/ thun mong du so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ pra༞ oṃ badzra puṣpe pra༞ oṃ badzra dhū pe pra༞ oṃ badzra ā lo ke pra༞ oṃ badzra gandhe pra༞ oṃ badzra nai wi dye pra༞ oṃ badzra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ mchod rol dang sprin gzungs med/ bstod pa shur ma dril bsil bcas/ bcom ldan lha mo gdugs dkar can/ /zhal stong thugs rje'i spyan dang ldan/ /phyag stong 'jigs pa kun las skyobs/ /gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal/ /bstan pa srung mdzad bgegs dpung 'joms/ /gzhan gyi mi thub stobs po che/ /legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig can/ /legs ldan rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ded dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas dril bu chig brdung bcas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/ de nas rnga rol thogs la/ bcom dung gsum rgyun bzhin/ bcom rol sbraṃ sbraṃ sbraṃ 'di rnams 'phar chen sbraṃ sbraṃ sogs chem brdung yun ci rigs 'phar med sbraṃ 1/ chung gsum 'phar chen 'phar med 123/ byas/ 123byas/ che gcig hūm̐ 'dren bcas shlau ka gcig la shar phyogs sgo srung ma'i dbyangs/ hūm̐ sngon gyi grong khyer sum brtsegs ni/ /nag po chen po 'jig pa'i tshe/ /bde gshegs sprul sku'i gtsug tor nas/ /gdugs dkar can gyi lha mor sprul/ /la rnga brda/ la la rol mo med/ sbraṃ sbraṃ 123byas/ 123byas/ che gcig de nas 'dur shur gang rung bcas/

gtsug tor gdugs dkar byin rlabs kyis/ /nag po chen po dam la btags/ /nag po chen po mnyes byas nas/ /grong khyer sum brtsegs brtan par byas/ /sum brtsegs pa yi mi rnams kyis/ /mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad bzlog /sum brtsegs pa yi la rnga brda/ mi mthun rkyen dang la tshig rol/ de nas 'dur shur gang rung bcas/ hūm̐ dam can sgrub mchog bdag gis kyang / /gtsug tor gdugs dkar dam can la/ /mchod dang gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi/ /mchod dang gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /grong khyer chen po sum brtsegs bzhin/ /grong khyer 'di yang bsrung du gsol/ /sum brtsegs pa yi mi bzhin du/ /grong khyer 'di na gnas pa yi/ /bzhugs dang mi bzhugs thams cad kyi/ /mi mthun bar chad bzlog tu gsol/ /gzhan gyis bsgrub pa'i rig sngags bzlog /gzhan gyis 'bebs pa'i pho nya bzlog /rgyal mtshan 'di yis nus pa yi/ /byang phyogs cha 'di bsrung du gsol/ /byang gi gdon tshogs phyir bzlog cing / /'byor dang bkra shis tshur gsol cing / /byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /gnod sbyin tshogs dang bcas pa la/ /rgyal mtshan 'di ni gnyer du 'bul/ /srung zhing skyobs pa'i phrin las mdzod/ /grong khyer 'di yi byang phyogs su/ /rgyal mtshan 'di ni btsugs pa yis/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par shog /zhi rgyas dbang la rnga brda/ phrin las rnam bzhi la tshig rol byas la rnga rol bzhag brtan bzhugs ni/ slob dpon sogs kyis rdor dril/ gzhan ma rnams kyis rnga rol bcas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya nang las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du mya ngan las mi mda' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang rgyal mtshan 'di nyid la sa dang / chu dang / me dang /

rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du sems can thams cad kyi don dpag tu med par mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ slob dpon sogs kyis rdo dril me tog 'thor/ gzhan ma rnams kyis mchod rol dung sgang dung gnyis dung gsal bcas/ las slob kyis gu gul bdug pa sogs mi dgos/ mchod rol sbugs kyi sngags nang / oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bhā wa he tunte ṣanta thā ga to hya datte ṣañtsa yo ṇi ro dha e waṃ bā di ma hā shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ phyogs bcu na nas 'di bar tshar gsum/ oṃ su pra dang rten 'brel snying po ci mang / rnga rol rnams bzhag rdor dril dang bcas bkra shis ni/ chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang / /sogs shlau ka gcig bde gshegs thugs rje'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing / /bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed phyir bzlog cing / /bde chen 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bde gshegs gdugs dkar can gyi bkra shis shog /'gro ba'i bla ma chos rje paṇḍi ta/ /sogs shlau ka gcig mthar rol mo dung sgang dung gnyis rgyun gyi bkra shis nang bzhin/ de nas mthar rgyal mtshan de nyid shar gyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs nang phyogs su bstan/ lho ru/ dzam bha na kā ri hūm̐ bhrūm̐/ bris pa'i rtsibs lho phyogs su bstan/ de bzhin du nub tu de nyid nub phyogs su bstan te 'gre/ byang du'ang de bzhin/ tog la sku dngos yod na rang rang phyogs la zhal ston/ sngar gyi 'dzugs sa rnying pa yod na de nyid du btsugs/ med na sgo khang gi steng du legs par 'dzugs rlung sogs kyis mi 'gul bar brtan par byas/ de nas zhwa phud gral la 'khod/ pad skor sngon 'gro'i so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra shapta pra tītstsha ye swāhā/ slob dpon gyis rdor dril/ gzhan pa rnams kyis mchod rol dung sgang dung gnyis dung gsal bcas/ sbugs kyi mchod pa'i sprin gzungs/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badzra sa ra pra mardha ni ta thā ga tā ya arha te samyaksaṃ budha ya/ ta dya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā te dzwa badzre/ ma hā bidya badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ pra ma ṇa badzre/ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha na badzre swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas rnga rol rnams bzhag rdor dril thogs la/ tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su dril bu bsil g.yas rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka gdangs bcas/ bde chen dbang phyug mchog gi gtso/ /zhal gsum rtsa zhal ku sha'i mdog /g.yas sngo g.yon dmar khro zhing 'dzum/ /gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdugs dkar rdo rje mda' dang ni/ /dgra satwa g.yas kyi phyag gis 'dzin/ /rgyal mtshan 'khor lo gzhu zhags pa/ /g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sku mdog gangs kyi ri ltar dkar/ /zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob/

/gtsug tor las byung khyod phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pa'am yang na/ mnyam med ma/ gang rigs kyis bstod/ de nas slob dpon sbyin bdag dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar la lag tu me tog thogs/ 'di skad ces brjod pa bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / yams kyi nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad rab tu zhi bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ ces lan gsum brjod/ phan yon brjod pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi lha tshogs thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin du rgyal mtshan bzhengs su gsol te/ mchod pa'i tshogs ci 'byor pa bshams/ 'phags pa'i tshogs spyan drangs shing / mchod bstod gtor ma phul te gsol ba btab pa dang gzungs sngags bzlas shing 'byung po rnams gtor mas tshims par byas pa'i mthus bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa sems can thams cad kyi nad dang / gdon dang / rims dang / dgra dang / bgegs dang / dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs la sogs pa 'gal rkyen spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ mdor na sngon sems can rnams la thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas/ lha gnas dam pa sum cu rtsa gsum gyi chos bzang lha yi mdun sa ru dpal gyi mgul nas 'di skad du/

mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / yams kyi nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa thams cad dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te/ rim gro cher mchod pa chen po byas la grong khyer thams cad kyi sgo'am/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong brdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i gnas su gzugs so/ /'phags ma gzhan gyi mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa chen mo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di rim gro cher byas te btsugs na btsugs ma thag tu yul du zhi bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /yams kyi nad dang / 'tshe ba dang / gnod pa dang / nad 'go ba dang / 'khrug pa dang / pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi 'phral du thob pa ci gnang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa'i tshad mar gyur pas/ ji ltar bka' stsal pa bzhin bden pa mngon sum du bstan pa ci gnang / gzungs las gsungs pa'i phan yon rnams/ /sbyin bdag dang ni 'gro kun la/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyi/ /'grub par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod la re re'i mtshams su rgyal mtshan la me tog 'thor/ de nas rdor dril bcas spos mi dgos/ bcom dril tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su rdo rje ma'i g.yas par bzhugs pa'i stangs ka bcas ji ltar sangs rgyas dang po gnyis gdangs ring / gsum pa gdangs bcas rgyun bzhin la tshar gsum gyis/ ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad ni/ /dga' ldan du ni gnas pa na/ /lha mo sgyu 'phrul lhums bzhugs ltar/ /de bzhin gzugs brnyan lhan cig tu/

/'di ru mgon po rtag bzhugs nas/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /yon gyi bdag po'i don slad du/ /bdag gis 'byor pa nyid kyis ni/ /ci 'byor pa yi mchod pa dang / /me tog la sogs 'di bzhes shig /bdag dang sbyin bdag bcas pa la/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs nas/ /kun gyis 'di la byin brlabs cing / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs par rigs/ /zhes brjod/ brtan bzhugs ni/ chab bcas bzhengs la/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du mya ngan las mi mda' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang rgyal mtshan 'di dag la sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du sems can thams cad kyi don dpag tu med pa mdzad cing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pas gtso byas/ sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ slob dpon sogs kyis dril bsil me tog gtor/ gzhan ma rnams kyis/ mchod rol dung sgang dung gnyis dung gsal bcas/ gu gul gyi bdug pa sogs mi dgos/ mchod rol sbugs la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swāhā/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā hi tunte ṣanta thā ga to hya datte ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇa ya swāhā/ zhes brjod/ phyogs bcu na nas 'di bar tshar gsum/ oṃ su pra dang / rten 'brel snying po ci mang bzlas nas gral la 'khod de nas zhwa gyon/ rdor dril bcas tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su dril bu bsil/ g.yas rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka gdangs bcas/ bde gshegs sku bzang mthong bas ltar/ /rgyal ba 'khor bcas deng 'dir bkra shis shog /ngan sdig log pa'i tshogs rnams bcom gyur nas/

/rgyal sras rig 'dzin tshogs rnams 'phel dar zhing / /zhal mthong tsam gyis bde ba'i mchog brnyes nas/ /nyi ltar zhal gro zla ltar 'od gsal zhing / /bdag dang 'gro la zhal gro byin che nas/ /bskal pa'i mthar thug bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /skul mtshams/ ji srid me dang chu dang ni/ /rlung gi bskal pas 'jig bar du/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bcom ldan khyod ni bzhugs par mdzod/ /rdor dril bzhag yig brgya ni/ oṃ badzra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra satwa twe no pa tiṣṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bhā wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi me pra yatstsha sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ shrī ya ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥbha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa badzri bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa ā/ thal mo sbyar mgon po'i bskal pa shlau ka gcig la/ ma 'byor ma'i gdangs tshar gcig mgon po'i bskal pa ji bzhin du/ /sna tshogs gzugs ni bzung nas kyang / /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams rnams su/ /des nas 'gro don kun tu mdzod/ /ces brjod de nas/ rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs bla ma yi dam chos srung nor lha rnams kyis bkra shis 'os 'tshams kyi mthar rol chen/ sgang dung gnyis sogs rgyun gyis bkra shis bzhin no/ /zhwa phud de nas nang du 'ong / sbyin bdag la srung ba byed na/ sbyin bdag la skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa phog la/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ byabs srung nas 'byung ba ltar srungs shig ces pa'i tshig rnams brjod/ sngar bshad pa ltar gyi bsrung ba de lta bu sbyin bdag gi mgul du btags/ de nas slob dpon gyi me tog dang bcas pas 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ sus de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir bzlog pa'i rig sngags gyi rgyal mo 'di gro ga'am ras sam shing shun la bris te lus sam mgul du btags sam klog par byed na/

de ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ dug gis mi tshugs/ mes mi tshugs/ chus mi tshugs/ dbyig dug gis mi tshugs/ dug sbyar mas mi tshugs/ byad kyis mi tshugs/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /gdon thams cad dang bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje rigs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi rnams dang / grub pa'i lha mo rnams kyis kyang / de la rtag tu mthun par srung ba dang / skyabs pa dang / sbed par byed cing de rnams kyis yid du 'ong ba dang / dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje rigs bskal pa chen po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhir skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje'i pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhis kyang rtag par yongs su skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /nam du yang gnod sbyin dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang / srul po dang / lus srul po nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /mi dbul por mi 'gyur/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis bsrung ba dang / bskyabs pa dang / sbed par mdzad cing / de dag gi thugs su byon pa dang dgyes par yang 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba gzhan gyi mi thub ma phyir bzlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di 'chang na/ tshangs par mi spyod pa yang tshangs par spyod par 'gyur ro/ /thub par ma byas pa yang thub par byas par 'gyur ro/ /mi gtsang ba yang gtsang bar 'gyur ro/ /smyung bar ma byas pa yang smyung bar byas par 'gyur ro/ /mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro/ /sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa yang ma lus par zad par 'gyur ro/

/zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i phan yon ji skad bka' stsal pa thams cad sbyin pa'i bdag po la sogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyis phral du thob pa ci gnang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' yang dag pa'i tshad mar gyur pas ji ltar bka' stsal ba bzhin bden pa mngon sum du bstan pa ci gnang / gzungs las gsungs pa'i phan yon rnams/ /sbyin bdag dang ni 'gro kun la/ /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas kyis/ /'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ces brjod la sbyin bdag la me tog 'thor/ de nas sbyin bdag gis slob dpon la phyag dang yon phul te bka' drin che'o zhes brjod/ 'jigs pa dang bcas pa'i tshe bsrung ba btags pas slob dpon dang / gnas dang / dus dang / bsrung ba phan yon dang bcas pa dran pa byas te/ yid ches par bya'o/ /'di sbyin bdag dang bsrung ba rnams yod na ma gtogs rgyun du mi dgos/ de nas las slob kyis mchod pa rnams gsar du bshams pa'am/ yang na kha gsos/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bha wa shuddho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyis nang du oṃ oṃ dpag tu med pa zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod rdzas kyi bye brag ji snyed yod pa thams cad rang bzhin stong pa rnams mchod yon la sogs pa mchod rdzas so sor snang ba/ ngo bo zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can skyed nus pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin can 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung ltar bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig

nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dpral bar bskor nas mthar se gol bcas/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a warta ya a warta ya hoḥbadzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shapta āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin gyis rlabs/ mchod rol sprin gzungs med/ de nas pad skor sngon du 'gro/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tītstsha ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta pa tre sa pa ri wā ra shapta pra tītstsha ye āḥhūm̐/ slob dpon sogs kyis dril bsil/ rdo rje snying ga gzhan ma rnams kyis mchod rol/ dung sgang dung gnyis dung gsal bcas/ mchod pa'i sprin gzungs bcas/ mchod pa'i sprin gzungs ni mchod rol gyi sbugs la/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo bhā ga wa te/ badzra sa ra pra mardha ni/ ta thā ga ta ya arha te samyaksaṃ buddha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā te dzwo badzre/ ma hā bidya badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ pra ma ṇa badzre sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shwa dha na badzre swāhā/

rnga rol bzhag de nas 'dod yon lnga so so'i phyag rgya/ gos zung 'di las slob kyi sngon ma nas bcas tshar ba dgos shapta la rol chen parṣe la gos zung 'bul tshul bzhin shur mas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta tre sa pa ri wā ra rū pa pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta tre sa pa ri wā ra shapta pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta tre sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta tre sa pa ri wā ra ra se pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta tre sa pa ri wā ra parṣe pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de nas gos zung rnams bsdus/ rgyal srid sna bdun rtags brgyad la/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya'i mthar se gol bcas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta tre sa pa ri wā ra sapta ratna pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ rtags brgyad la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇi ṣa si tā ta tre sa pa re wā ra aṣṭa maṅga la bhyaḥgra pu dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas bstod pa ni/ mjug dril bsil g.yas rdo rje phyag 'tshal ba'i stangs ka dang bcas/ bde gshegs thugs rje'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing / /bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed phyir bzlog cing / /bde chen 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i/ /bde gshegs gdugs dkar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas thal sbyar bcas/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyi mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir gyi bstan pa'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/

bstan pa'i rtsa lag gong ma zhi bar gshegs pa rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad thugs zag pa med pa'i dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ da lta bzhugs pa'i dpal ldan bla ma rnams kyis gtso mdzad pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe brtan pa byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang / sgrib pa dam tshig nyams chag thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mtho ris dang thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam gyi bar du gcod pa dang / mi dge ba dang / nyon mongs pa dang / shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ gnas skabs su yang las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba'i gnod pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi bye brag gdon chen sogs bco brgyad dang / bgegs rigs dang / stong phrag brgyad cu dang / log 'dren dang / gza' dang rgyu skar dang / byad stims dang / pha rol gyis rig sngags las gyur pa'i gnod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ me dang / chu dang / sa g.yo ba la sogs pa 'byung ba las gyur pa'i gnod pa dang / lo nyes dang dgra'i gnod pa la sogs pa 'jigs pa chen po bcu drug dang / mu ge dang / mi nad dang / phyugs nad dang / nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi dang / dbul zhing 'phongs pa dang / dus ma yin pa 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang / de dag gi sdug bsngal bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi/ sngon gyi las su gyur kyang rung / phral gyi rkyen las gyur kyang rung ste phyi nang gi nye bar 'tshe ba dang / lus sems la gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs dang nad la sogs pa lus kyi sdug bsngal ba dang / sems yid mi bde ba dang / skal pa ngan pa dang / rmi lam ngan pa dang / mtshan ma ngan pa dang / lus dang srog dang longs spyod dang /

skal ba dang / dge ba sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ mdor na bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi gnas skabs su yang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi nas 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug pa'i 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub mtha' dag sgrub pa dang / mthar thug sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus par zhi ba'i phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ spro na bla ma'i brtan bzhugs 'dod gsol bya na 'dir bya'o/ /yang thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag cag rnams so so skye bor gyur pa'i sems can nyon mongs pa can du gyur nas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa nyon mongs pa dang 'dres zhing bag med par gyur nas rnal 'byor la dbang ma thob pas sems bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / snyigs ma lnga'i dus kyi dbang gi nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad ma 'byor ba dang mchod rdzas ngan zhing ngan pa dang / brjed nges pa dang / shes bzhin ma yin pa'i dbang du gyur nas/ cho ga lhag pa dang / chad pa dang / ser sna'i dbang gi mchod pa ngan zhing chung ba dang / gti mug gi dbang gis rgyud sde nas byung ba'i cho ga bzhin du ma lcogs pa la sogs pa'i 'khrul zhing nongs pa thams cad bzod par bzhes nas bdag cag gi sa lam dang dngos grub gi bar chad du mi 'gyur ba byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ 'di gnyis tshar re brjod/ de nas yig brgya lan gsum/ de nas thal mo spyi bor sbyar la/ 'dir tshigs bcad gcig mi gsal/ ser sna'i dbang gyur mi mkhas sogs/ /mchod pa ngan cing bsham nyes pa/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa yi/
